22.3: Aka, ina i puka mai ka la maluna ona, alaila, ua pili no kona koko. Ua pono no ia ia ke uku pau loa mai, a ina i nele oia, alaila, ua pono ke kuaiia oia no kona aihue ana.
22.4: Ina i loaa maopopo ma kona lima ka mea i aihueia e ola ana, ina he bipi, a ina he hoki a ina he hipa paha, e haawi aku no oia i papalua.
22.5: Ina e hoopau ke kanaka i ko ka mala, a i ko ka pawaina, a hookomo i kona holoholona iloko: a ai oia maloko o ka mala a hai, alaila e uku aku oia i kahi maikai o kana mala iho, a me kahi maikai o kaua pawaina.
22.6: A ina holo aku ke ahi, a loaa na kakalaioa, a aiia na puu huapalaoa, a o ka hua palaoa e ku ana paha, a o ko ka mala paha, alaila, e oiaio no e uku aku ka mea nana i kuni i ke ahi.
22.7: Ina haawi ke kanaka i wahi kala na kona hoalauna e malama, a i waiwai e paha, a ua aihueia mai kona hale aku, ina e loaa ka mea nana i aihue, e uku papalua aku oia.
22.8: Ina aole i loaa ka mea nana i aihue, alaila, e laweia mai ka hakuhale i na lunakanawai, ina paha ua kau aku oia i kona lima maluna o ka waiwai o kona hoalauna.
22.9: O na hewa no kela mea keia mea, no ka bipi, no ka hoki, no ka hipa, no ka aahu, no na mea nalowale a pau a kekahi e olelo ai, nana ia, e laweia ko laua pono imua o na lunakanawai, a o ka mea a na lunakanawai e hoohewa ai, e uku papalua aku oia i kona hoalauna.
22.10: Ina haawi ke kanaka i hoki na kona hoalauna e malama, a i bipi paha, a i hipa, a i kekahi holoholona e ae nana, a i make ia, a eha, a hooholoia ma kahi e paha, aole mea i ike aku;
22.11: Alaila, mawaena o laua ka hoohiki ana ia Iehova, aole oia i kau i kona lima maluna o ka waiwai o kona hoalauna; a e ae aka no ka mea nana ka waiwai, aole kela e uku.
22.12: Aka, ina i aihueia'ku ia mea, mai ona aka, e uka aku no oia i ka mea nana ka waiwai.
22.13: Ina e haehaeia oia, alaila, e lawe mai kela i ke kino, i mea koike, aole hoi oia e uku no ka mea i haehaeia.
22.14: A ina nonoi ke kanaka i kekahi mea a kona hoalauna, a eha ia mea, a make paha, aole e noho pu ana ka mea nana ia, alaila, e oiaio no e uku oia.
22.15: Aka ina e noho pu ana ka mea nana ka waiwai, alaila, aole oia e uku mai. Ina he mea hoolimalima, ua loaa ia no ka uku.
22.16: Ina e pue ke kanaka i ke kaikamahine i noopalau ole ia, a moe pu me ia, e oiaio no e kuai no oia ia ia i wahine nana.
22.17: Ina hoole loa kona makuakane aole e haawi ia ia nana, e kaupauna aku oia i kala e like me ke kuai ana i na wahinepuupaa.
22.18: Mai hoola i ke kupua.
22.19: O ka mea moe pu me ka holoholona, e oiaio no e make ia.
22.20: O ka mea mohai aku na kekahi akua e, aole na Iehova, e luku loa ia'ku la ia.
22.21: Mai hookaumaha oe i ka malihini, aole hoi e hooluhi ia ia, no ka mea, he poe malihini oukou ma ka aina o Aignpita.
22.22: Mai hookaumaha oe i ka wahinekanemake, a me ke keiki makun ole.
22.23: Ina hookaumaha iki oe in lakou, a uwe uuku mai lakou ia'u, e oiaio no e hoolohe au i ko lakou uwe ana:
22.24: A e wela auanei ko'u huhu, a e pepehi aku au ia oukou i ka pahikaua, a e lilo no ka oukou wahine i wahinekanemake a me ka oukou kamalii i kamalii makua ole.
22.25: Ina haawi aie aku oe i ke kala no ko'u poe kanaka i hune e noho pu ana me oe, mai lilo oe ia ia i mea hoouku kuala, mai kau hoi oe i ka uku hoopanee maluna ona.
22.26: Ina lawe iki oe i ka aahu o kou hoalauna i ukupanai, e haawi hou aku no oe ia ia ia i ka wa e napoo ai ka la ilalo:
22.27: No ka mea, oia kona mea e uhi ai, o kona aahu no kona ili. Maloko o ke aba oia e moe ai? A hiki i ka manawa e uwe mai ai oia ia'u e hoolohe no wau, no ka mea, ua lokomaikai no au.
22.28: Mai olelo hoino oe i na lunakanawai, aole hoi e olelo hoino i ka mea e noho alii ana maluna o ko'u poe kanaka.
22.29: Mai aua oe i kau ai i oo mua, a me kou waina mua, E haawi mai no oe i kau hiapo, o kau mau keikikane na'u.
22.30: Pela no oe e hana'i me kau mau bipi a me kau poe hipa; ehiku la e noho ai me kona makuwahine, a i ka walu o ka la, e haawi mai oe ia mea ia'u.
22.31: A e lilo auanei oukou i poe kanaka hoano no'u, aole hoi oukou e ai i ka io i haehaeia e na holoholona ma ke kula, e kiola aku oukou ia na na ilio.

23.1: MAI hoala oe i ka olelo wahahee. Mai kau pu i kou lima me ka poe hewa e lilo i mea hoike hookaumaha.
23.2: Mai hahai mamuli o ka lehulehu e hana hewa, mai paue aku hoi ma ke ku e mamuli o ka lehulehu, e hoohewa wale.
23.3: Mai kokua oe mamuli o ka ilihune i kona hewa ana.
23.4: Ina halawai oe me ka bipi a kou hoalauna e hele hewa ana, me kona hoki paha, e oiaio no e hoihoi mai oe ia mea io na la.
23.5: Ina ike oe i ka hoki a ka mea i huhu mai ia oe, o moe ana malalo iho o kona kaumaha, a manao oe aole kokua ia ia, alaila, e kokua aku no oe ia ia.
23.6: Mai hookahuli oe i ka pono o ke kanaka hune i kona hookolokolo ana.
23.7: E mamao aku oe i ka mea wahahee; a mai pepehi oe i ka mea i hewa ole, a me ka mea i pono: no ka mea, aole au e hoapono aku i ka mea i hewa.
23.8: Mai lawe oe i ka waiwai kipe: no ka mea, o ka waiwai kipe ka mea e makapo ai ka poe ike, a e kekee ai na olelo a ka poe pono.
23.9: Mai hookaumaha oe i ka malihini, no ka mea, ua ike no oukou i ka manao o ka malihini, no ko oukou noho malihini ana ma ka aina o Aigupita.
23.10: E lulu oe i kou aina i eono mau makahiki, a e hoiliili hoi i kona hua.
23.11: Aka i ka hiku o ka makahiki e hoomaha oe i ka aina, e waiho wale hoi; i ai iho ka poe hune o kou poe kanaka; a o ka mea a lakou e hookoe ai, na na holoholona o ke kula ia e ai. Pela no oe e hana'i i kon pawaina, a me kon laau oliva.
23.12: I na la eono e hana'i oe i kau hana, a e hoomaha hoi i ka la hiku; i hoomaha ai kau bipi a me kou hoki, i hoohoihoiia hoi ke koikikane a kau kauwa wahine, a me ka malihini.
23.13: Ma na mea a pau au i olelo ai ia oukou e malama ia oukou iho; mai hai iki i ka inoa o na'kna e, aole hoi e loheia ia ma kon waha.
23.14: E malama oe i ekolu ahaaina no u i ka makahiki.
23.15: E malama oe i ka ahaaina o ka berena huole: Ehikn la oe e ai ai i ka berena huole, me a'u i kanoha aka ai ia oe, i ka manawa i haawiia, ma ka malama o Abiba; no ka mea, ia wa oe i hele mai ai mailoko mai o Aigupita: Mai ikeia nae kekahi imua o'u me ka waiwai ole:
23.16: A me ka ahaaina o ka ohi mua ana, o na hua mua hoi o kau hooikaika ana, ka mea au i lulu ai ma ke kola, a me ka ahaaina o ka hoiliili ai ana, oia hoi ka hope o ka makahiki, i kou wa e hoiliili ai mailoko mai o ke kula, i kau mea i hooikaika ai.
23.17: E ikeia no ko oukou poe kane a pau imua o Iehova ke Akua, i ekolu no ikea ana i ka makahiki hookahi.
23.18: Mai kaumaha aku oe i ke koko o ko'u mohai, me ka berena hu, aole hoi e hookoeia ke kelekele o ka'u ahaaina a kakahiaka.
23.19: E lawe mai no oe iloko o ka hale o Iehova, kou Akua, i ka mua o na hua mua o kou aina. Mai hoolapalapa oe i ke kaokeiki malokool ka waiu o kona makuwahine.
23.20: Aia hoi, e hoouna aku ana au i ko'u Anela mamua on, e malama ia oe ma ke ala, a e hookomo ia oe i kahi a'u i hoomakaukau ai.
23.21: E ao ia ia e hoolohe i kona leo, mai hoohuhu aku ia ia; no ka mea, aole ia e kala mai i kon hewa: aia hoi, maloko ona ko'u inoa.
23.22: Aka, ina hoolohe io mai oe i kona leo, a e hana hoi i na mea a'u e olelo aku ai: alaila, e lilo wau i enemi no kou poe enemi, a e hana ino aku au i ka mea e hana ino mai ia oe.
23.23: No ka mea, e hele ana ko'u Anela mamua on, a e kai aku ia oe i kahi o ka Amora a me ka Heta a me ka Pereza, a me ko Kanaana, a me ka Heva a me ka Iebusa, a na'u no lakou e anai aku.
23.24: Mai kulou oe i ko lakou akua, aole hoi e malama aku ia lakou, aole hoi e hana aku mamuli o ka lakou hana: aka, e hookahuli loa oe ia lakou, a e wawahi loa i ko lakou mau kii.
23.25: E malama hoi oukou ia Iehova i ko oukou Akua; alaila, nana no e hoomaikai i kau ai, a me kon wai; a e lawe aku no hoi i ka mai, mailoko aku ou.
23.26: Aole loa e poholo wale ka hanau ana o kekahi mea ma kon aina, aole hoi e pa; e hooko no wau i kou mau la.
23.27: Na'u no e haawi i ka makau mamna on, a na'u no e luku aku i na kanaka a pau, ma kahi au e hele aku ai, a na'u no e hana aku i kou poe enemi, i huli ai ko lakou kua ia oe.
23.28: A na'u no e hoouna aku i nalohopeeha mamna ou, na lakou no e kipaku aku i ka Heva, a me ko Kanaana, a me ka Heta, mamua ou,
23.29: Aole nae au e kipaku aku ia lakou mamua on i ka makahiki hookahi; o nahelehele ka aina, a nui loa iho na holoholona hihiu e alo mai ia oe.
23.30: E kipaku liill aku au ia lakou mai kou alo aku, a lilo oe i nui, a ill mai ka aina nou.
23.31: A na'u no e kau i kon palena mai ke Kaiula, a hiki i ke kai o Pilisetia, a mai ka waonahele hoi a hiki i ka muliwai; no ka mea, e haawi aku ana au i na kanaka o ia aina i ko oukou lima; a e kipaku aku oe ia lakou mai kou alo aku.
23.32: Mai hoopaa berita me lakou, aole hoi me ko lakou mau akua.
23.33: Aole lakou e noho i kou aina, o hoolilo lakou ia oe i mea hana hewa mai ia'u; no ka mea, ina e malama oe i ko lakou mau akua, e lilo auanei ia i mea hoowalewale nou.

24.1: I MAI la oia ia Mose, E pii mai oe io Iehova nei, o oe, a me Aarona, a me Nadaba, a me Abihu, a me na lunakahiko o ka Iseraela he kanahiku; a e hoomana oukou ma kahi mamao aku.
24.2: A o Mose wale no ka mea hele mai a kokoke io Iehova nei: aka, o lakou aole hele mai a kokoke; aole hoi e pii pu na kanaka me ia.
24.3: Hoi ae la o Mose, a hai aku la i kanaka i na olelo a pau a Iehova, a me na kanawai a pau; hooho mai la na kanaka a pau me ka leo kahi, i mai la, O na olelo a pau a Iehova i olelo mai ai, e hana no makou.
24.4: A kahakaha iho la o Mose i na olelo a pau a Iehova, a ala'e la i kakahiaka nui, a kukulu iho la i kuahu malalo o ka mauna, a me na kia he umikumamalua, e like me na ohana he umikumamalua o ka Iseraela.
24.5: A hoouna ae la ia i mau kanaka ui o na mamo a Iseraela, na lakou i mohai aku i na mahaikuni, no Iehova, a kaumaha aku no hoi lakou i mau bipi kane i mohai hoomalu.
24.6: A lawe iho la o Mose i ka hapalua o ke koko, a waiho aku la maloko o na kiaha, a kapipi iho la ia i kekahi hapalua o ke koko maluna o ke kuahu.
24.7: A lawe iho la ia i ka buke o ka berita, a heluhelu ma na pepeiao o na kanaka. Olelo aku la lakou, E hana no makou i na mea a pau a Iehova i olelo mai ai, a e hoolohe no.
24.8: A lawe ae la o Mose i ke koko, a kapipi iho la maluna o na kanaka, olelo mai la, Aia hoi ke koko o ka berita a Iehova i hana mai ai me oukou no keia mau olelo a pau.
24.9: Alaila, pii aku la o Mose, a me Aarona, a me Nadaba, a me Abihu, a me na lunakahiko o ka Iseraela.
24.10: A ike aku la lakou i ke Akua o ka Iseraela, a malalo iho o kona mau wawae he mea me he sapeiro ka aiai, e like hoi me ke kino o na lani ke kalae.
24.11: Aole ia i kau mai i kona lima maluna o na luna o na mamo o ka Iseraela. A ike no lakou i ke Akua, a ai no, a inu no hoi.
24.12: Olelo mai la o Iehova ia Mose, E hele mai oe io'u nei i ka mauna, a e noho malaila; a e haawi aku au ia oe i pohaku papa, me ke kanawai, a me na kauoha a'u i palapala ai, i ao aku oe ia mea.
24.13: Ku ae la o Mose iluna, a me kana kauwa o Iosua: a pii aku la o Mose i ka mauna o ke Akua.
24.14: Olelo iho la ia i na lunakahiko, E kakali oukou no maua, a hoi mai maua ia oukou: aia hoi, me oukou o Aarona haua me Hura; a o ka mea loaa kahi pilikia, e hele ae ia io laua la.
24.15: Pii aku la o Mose i ka mauna, a uhi mai la ka ohu i ka mauna.
24.16: Puwa mai la ka nani a Iehova maluna o ka mauna i Sinai, a uhi mai la ka ohu maluna iho i na la eono; a i ka hiku o ka la hea mai la oia ia Mose, maloko mai o ka ohu.
24.17: I na maka o na mamo a Iseraela, i ka nana ana i ka nani o Iehova, ua like ia me ke ahi e ai ana ma ke poo o ka mauna.
24.18: Hele aku la o Mose iloko pono o ka ohu, a pii aku la i ka mauna, a malaila no o Mose ma ka mauna hookahi kanaha ao, hookahi kanaha po.

25.1: OLELO mai o Iehova ia Mose, i mai la,
25.2: E i aku oe i na mamo a Iseraela, e lawe mai lakou i mohaimakana na'u. E lawe no oukou na'u i ka mohaimakana o kela kanaka keia kanaka i haawi oluolu mai me kona naau.
25.3: Eia hoi ka mohaimakana a oukou e lawe ai no lakou mai, he gula, he kala, he keleawe,
25.4: He lole uliuli, a me ka poni, a me ka ulaula, a me ka lole olona keokeo, a me ka hulu kao,
25.5: A me na ili hipakane i hooluu ulaula ia, a me na ili tehasa, a me ka laau sitima,
25.6: I aila hoi i mea malamalama, a me na hua ala, i mea aila poni, a i mea ala maikai,
25.7: A me na pohaku saredonuka, i mea e hoonohonoho ai iloko o ka epoda, a iloko o ka paleumauma.
25.8: A e hana hoi lakou i keenakapu no'u, i noho ai au iwaena o lakou.
25.9: E like me na mea a pau a'u e hoike aku ai ia oe, o ke kumu hoohalike o ke keenakapu, a me ke kumu hoohalike o kona mau mea e pili ana, pela no oe e hana'i.
25.10: A e hana no lakou i pahu laau sitima, i elua kubita a me ka hapalua kona loihi, i hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona laula, a hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona kiekie.
25.11: A e uhi no hoi oe ia me ke gula maikai, maloko, a mawaho oe e uhi ai ia, a e hana no hoi oe maluna i lei gula a puni ia mea.
25.12: A e hoohehee oe i eha apo gula nona, a e hookomo ma na kihi eha o ka pahu, i elua apo ma kekahi aoao ona, a i elua apo ma kekahi aoao ona.
25.13: A e hana oe i mau auamo laau sitima, a e uhi ia mau mea i ke gula.
25.14: A e hookomo oe i na auamo maloko o na apo ma na aoao o ka pahu, i laweia ka pahu ma ia mau mea.
25.15: E paa no na auamo maloko o na apo o ka pahu, aole laua e laweia mai ka pahu aku.
25.16: A e waiho oe iloko o ka pahu i na papa kanawai a'u e haawi aku ai ia oe.
25.17: A e hana oe i nohoaloha, he gula maikai: i elua kubita a me ka hapalua kona loa, i hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona laula.
25.18: E hana no hoi oe i elua kerubima gula, e hana oe ia mau mea i gula paa wale no, ma na welau o ka nohoaloha.
25.19: E hana oe i kekahi kerubima ma kekahi welau, a i kekahi kerubima ma kela welau, ma ka nohoaloha kau e hana'i ia mau kerubima, ma kona mau welau elua.
25.20: A e hohola aku na kerubima i na eheu maluna, e uhi ana i ka nohoaloha i ko lakou mau eheu: a e ku pono no na maka o laua kekahi i kekahi E kau no ko laua mau maka ma ka nohoaloha.
25.21: A e kau no oe i ka nohoaloha maluna ma ka pahu; a maloko o ka pahu oe e waiho ai i na pahu kanawai a'u e haawi aku ai ia oe.
25.22: A malaila wau e halawai ai me oe, a e kamailio pu no hoi au me oe, mailuna iho o ka nohoaloha, a mawaena aku hoi o na kerubima maluna o ka pahu hoike, no na mea a pau a'u e kauoha aku ai i na mamo a Iseraela.
25.23: E hana no hoi oe i papaaina laau sitima: i elua kubita kona loihi, a i hookahi kubita kona laula, a i hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona kiekie.
25.24: A e uhi oe ia mea i ke gula maikai, a e hana hoi oe i lei gula a puni ia mea.
25.25: A e hana oe i kae a puni ia mea, i hookahi lima ka laula, a e hana no hoi oe i lei gula ma ua kae la a puni.
25.26: A e hana no hoi oe i eha apo gula no ua papaaina la, a e hookomo i ua mau apo la ma na kiki eha maluna o kona mau wawae.
25.27: E ku pono no na apo i na kae, i wahi e hookomo ai i na auamo e lawe ai i ua papaaina la.
25.28: A e hana oe i ua mau auamo la, he laau sitima, a e uhi ia mea i ke gula, i laweia ka papaaina maluna o laua.
25.29: A e hana oe i kona mau kiaha, a me kona mau puna, a me kona mau poi, a me kona mau ipu i mea ninini mohai E hana oe ia mau mea, he gula maikai.
25.30: E kau no hoi maluna o ka papaaina i berena hoike mau loa imua o'u.
25.31: A e hana no hoi i ipu kukui manamana he gula maikai, e hanaia ua ipukukui la a poepoe. O kona kumu, o kona mau lala, a me kona mau ipu, a me kona mau puupuu, a me kona mau pua, o ia apana hookahi no.
25.32: E puka mai no na lala eono ma na aoao ona; ekolu lala o ka ipukukui mailoko mai o kekahi aoao, a ekolu lala o ka ipukukui, mailoko mai o kekahi aoao.
25.33: Ekolu no ipu e like me na alemona, me ka puupuu a me ka pua, ma ka lala hookahi; a ekolu no ipu e like me na alemona, me ka puupuu a me ka pua, a pela ma na lala eono i puka mai, mailoko mai o ka ipukukui.
25.34: A ma ke kumuipukukui, eha no ipu e like me na alemona, me ko lakou mau puu a me ko lakou mau pua.
25.35: He puu malalo iho o kona mau lala elua, a he puu malalo iho o kona mau lala elua, a he puu malalo iho o kona mau lala elua, e like me na lala eono e puka mai ana mailoko mai o ua ipukukui la.
25.36: E hana hookahi ia na puu a me na lala, o kona mau mea a pau, he gula paa wale no.
25.37: A e hana no hoi oe i kona mau ipu aila ehiku, a e kau oia ia mau mea maluna, i hoomalamalama aku ai lakou ma kona alo.
25.38: A o kona upaahi a me kona upakolikukui, he gula maikai.
25.39: E hana no oia ia mea, a me kona mau mea hana, hookahi talena gula maikai.
25.40: E malama hoi oe e hana e like me ke kumu hoohalike i hoikeia ia oe ma ka mauna.

26.1: E HANA no oe i ka halelewa me na pale he umi, he olona i hiloia, he uliuli, he poni a me ka ulaula; he mau kerubima kekahi, o ka hana a ka poe akamai;
26.2: He iwakaluakumamawalu kubita ka loa o kekahi pale, a o ka laula o kekahi pale, eha no kubita. Hookahi no ana o na pale a pau.
26.3: E huiia na pale elima, o kekahi me kekahi, a e huiia na pale elima, o kekahi me kekahi.
26.4: A e hana oe i mau puka lou lole uliuli ma ke kihi o kekahi pale, ma ke kae kahi o ka hui ana, a e hana no hoi oe pela ma ke kihi loa o kekahi pale, ma ke kihi e hui ai me ka lua.
26.5: E hana oe i kanalima puka lou ma ka pale hookahi, a e hana hoi i kanalima puka lou ma ke kihi o ka pale, ma ka hui ana o ka lua, i lou ae kekahi puka lou i kekahi puka lou.
26.6: E hana no hoi oe i kanalima lou gula, a e hui i na pale me ua mau lou la. A e lilo i halelewa hookahi.
26.7: A e hana oe i mau pale hulu kao i mea uhi maluna o ka halelewa. I umikumamakahi pale kau e hana'i.
26.8: He kanakolu kubita ka loihi o kekahi pale, a i eha kubita ka laula o kekahi pale. E like no ke ana o ua mau pale la, he umikumamakahi.
26.9: A e hui oe i elima mau pale, i kaawale lakou, a e hui i eono mau pale, i kaawale lakou, a e pelu ae i ke ono o ka pale ma ke alo o ka halelewa.
26.10: A e hana oe i kanalima puka lou ma ke kihi o kekahi pale mawaho, ma ka hui ana, a i Kanalima puka lou ma ke kihi o ka pale i hui me ka lua.
26.11: A e hana oe i kanalima lou keleawe, a e hookomo i ua mau lou la iloko o na puka lou, a e hui i ua uhi la, i lilo ai i hookahi.
26.12: A o ka puehu ka mea i puehu aku o na pale o ua uhi la, a ka hapalua o ka pale puehu, e kau no ia ma ke kua o ka halelewa.
26.13: A o ke kubita ma kekahi aoao, a o ke kubita ma kela aoao, ka mea i puehu o ka loihi o na pale o ka hale, e kaulai no ia ma na aoao o ka halelewa, ma kela aoao, a ma keia aoao, i mea uhi nona.
26.14: E hana no hoi oe i uhi no ka hale he mau ili hipa kane i hooluu ulaula ia, a maluna aku i uhi hou, he mau ili tehasa.
26.15: A e hana oe i mau papa laau sitima no ka halelewa, i mea ku iluna.
26.16: He umi kubita ka loihi o kekahi papa, a he kubita a me ka hapalua ka laula o kekahi papa.
26.17: Elua komo ma ka papa hookahi, e ku pono kekahi i kekahi. Pela no oe e hana'i ma na papa a pau o ka halelewa.
26.18: A e hana no hoi oe i na papa o ka halelewa, i iwakalua papa ma ka aoao hema, ma ke kukulu hema hoi.
26.19: A e hana no hoi oe i hookahi kanaha kumu kala, malalo iho o na papa he iwakalua, i elua kumu maloko iho o ka papa hookahi, no kona mau komo elua, a i elua kumu malalo iho o kekahi papa no kona mau komo elua.
26.20: A no ka lua o ka aoao o ka halelewa ma ke kukulu akau, he iwakalua no papa:
26.21: A me ko lakou mau kumu kala, he kanaha, elua kumu malalo iho o kekahi papa, a elua kumu malalo iho o kekahi papa.
26.22: A no na aoao o ka halelewa ma ke komohana, e hana no oe i eono papa.
26.23: A e hana no hoi oe i elua papa no na kihi o ka halelewa, ma na aoao elua.
26.24: E huiia no ia mau mea malalo, a e huiia no hoi maluna, ma ke poo, a iloko o ke apo hookahi; pela no laua a elua, a no na kihi elua o laua.
26.25: Ewalu no ia mau papa, a me ko lakou mau kumu kala, he umikumamaono kumu, elua no kumu malalo o kekahi papa, a elua no kumu malalo o kekahi papa.
26.26: A e hana no hoi oe i mau laau ki, he sitima ka laau, i elima ki no na papa ma kekahi aoao o ka halelewa,
26.27: A i elima ki no na papa ma kekahi aoao o ka halelewa, a i elima ki hoi no na papa o na aoao o ka halelewa, no na aoao elua hoi ma ke komohana.
26.28: A o ke ki waena, mawaena konu o na papa, e holo no ia, mai kekahi kala a i kekahi kala.
26.29: E uhi no hoi oe i na papa i ke gula, a e hana no hoi oe i ko lakou mau apo, he gula, i wahi no na ki, a e uhi no noi oe i na ki i ke gula.
26.30: A e kukulu oe i ka halelewa me ke kumu hoohalike i hoikeia aku ai ia oe ma ka mauna.
26.31: A e hana hoi oe i paku, he uliuli a me ka poni a me ka ulaula, a me ke olona i hiloia, o ka hana a ka poe akamai: e hanaia hoi ia me na kerubima.
26.32: A e kaulai no hoi ia ma na kia laau sitima eha, i uhiia i ke gula; he gula no ko lakou mau lou, maluna o na kumu kala eha.
26.33: A e kaulai oe i ka paku malalo iho o na lou i lawe mai ai oe i ka pahu hoike malalo o ka paku; a na ka paku e hookaawale no oukou mawaena o kahi hoano, a me kahi hoano loa.
26.34: A e kau no oe i ka noho aloha maluna ma ka pahu hoike, maloko o kahi hoano loa.
26.35: E hoonoho oe i ka papaaina mawaho o ka paku, a e kau oe i ka ipukukui manamana ma ke alo o ka papaaina ma ka aoao o ka halelewa ma ke kukulu hema. A e hoonoho oe i ka papaaina ma ka aoao akau.
26.36: A e hana no hoi oe i pale no ka puka komo o ka halelewa, he uliuli, he poni, he ulaula, a me ke olona i hiloia, i hanaia e ka mea humuhumu lopi ano e.
26.37: E hana hoi oe i elima kia laau sitima no na pale, a e uhi ia mau mea i ke gula, a he gula hoi ko lakou mau lou; a e hoohehee i elima kumu keleawe no lakou.

27.1: E HANA oe i kuahu, he laau sitima, elima kubita ka loihi, elima hoi kubita ka lanla: eha no aoao o ke kuahu, a ekolu kubita kona kiekie.
27.2: A e hana oe i mau pepeiao ma kona mau kihi eha, no ia laau hookahi, a e uhi ia mau mea i ke keleawe.
27.3: E hana oe i kona mau ipu, i mea e lawe aku ai i kona lehu, a me kona mau mea hao lanahu, a me kona mau kiaha, a me kona lou io, a me kona mau ipu ahi, o kona mau oihana a pau, he keleawe.
27.4: E hana no hoi oe i papa manamana, pukapuka keleawe, a ma ia mea e hana oe i eha mau apo keleawe ma kona mau kihi eha.
27.5: A e waiho hoi ia mea malalo iho o ke kae o ke kuahu, i mau ai ua mea pukapuka la mawaena konu o ke kuahu.
27.6: E hana no hoi oe i mau auamo no ke kuahu, i mau auamo laau sitima, e uhi ia mau mea i ke keleawe.
27.7: A e hookomoia na auamo maloko o na apo, aia ma na aoao elua o ke kuahu, ua mau auamo la, e amo ai ia mea.
27.8: E hana oe ia mea me na papa, a kawaha mawaena; me ia i hoikeia'ku ai ia oe ma ka mauna, pela lakou e hana'i.
27.9: E hana no hoi oe i kahua no ka halelewa: no ka aoao akau, ma ke kukulu akau, i mau paku no ke kahua, he olona i hiloia, hookahi haneri kubita ka loihi no ka aoao hookahi:
27.10: A o kona mau pou, he iwakalua, me ko lakou mau kumu he iwakalua, o ke keleawe: o na lou o na kia, a me na auka e paa ai, he kala.
27.11: A no ka aoao akau hoi, ma ka loa, he mau paku, hookahi haneri kubita ka loihi, a me kona mau kia he iwakalua, a me ko lakou mau kumu he iwakalua: o na lou o na kia, a me ko lakou mau auka e paa ai, he kala.
27.12: A no ka laula o ke kahua ma ka aoao komohana, he mau paku no, he kanalima kubita ka loihi, he umi ko lakou mau kia, a he umi ko lakou mau kumu.
27.13: A o ka laula o ke kahua ma ka aoao hikina, ma ka hikina hoi, he kanalima ia mau kubita.
27.14: O na paku ma kekahi aoao, he umikumamalima kubita, ekolu o lakou mau kia, a me ko lakou mau kumu, ekolu no.
27.15: A ma kekahi aoao, he mau paku, he umikumamalima kubita, ekolu o lakou mau kia, a me ko lakou mau kumu, ekolu no.
27.16: A no ka puka o ke kahua, he paku, he iwakalua kubita ka loihi, he uliuli, he poni, he ulaula, a me ke olona i hiloia, i hanaia e ka mea humuhumu lopi ano e: eha ko lakou mau kia, a me ko lakou mau kumu eha.
27.17: O na kia a pau, a puni ke kahua, e hoopaaia lakou i na auka kala: a o ko lakou mau kumu he keleawe.
27.18: O ka loihi o ke kahua, hookahi haneri kubita, a o ka laula, he kanalima, mai o a o; a o ke kiekie, elima no kubita, he olona i hiloia, a o ko lakou mau kumu, he keleawe.
27.19: O na oihana a pau o ka halelewa, na mea e lawelawe ai a me kona mau makia a pau, a me na makia a pau o ke kahua, he keleawe.
27.20: E kauoha hoi oe i na mamo a Iseraela, e lawe mai lakou nou, i aila oliva maikai, i kuiia, no ka malamalama, i mea e aa mau ai ka ipukukui.
27.21: Ma ka halelewa o ka ahakanaka, mawaho o ka paku, imua o ka pahu kauawai, na Aarona a me kana mau keiki ia e hooponopono, mai ke ahiahi a kakahiaka imua o Iehova. He kanawai mau loa ia no ko lakou hanauna, no na mamo a Iseraela.

28.1: E LAWE oe iou la ia Aarona, i kou kaikuaana, a me kana mau keikikane pu me ia, mai waena mai o na mamo a Iseraela, i lawelawe oia na'u ma ka oihana a ke kahuna, o Aarona, o Nadaba, o Abihu, o Eleazara, a me Itamara, na keikikane a Aarona.
28.2: A e hana hoi oe i aahu laa no Aarona, no kou kaikuaana, i mea nani, a i mea maikai.
28.3: E olelo aku no hoi oe i ka poe a pau i akamai ma ka naau, ka poe a'u i hoopiha ai i ka manao akamai, e hana lakou i ko Aarona mau aahu, e hookapu ia ia, i lawelawe oia na'u, ma ka oihana a ke kahuna.
28.4: Eia na aahu a lakou e hana'i: he paleumauma, he epoda, he holoku, he palule onionio, he papale hainika, a me ke kaei. E hana no lakou i aahu kapu no Aarona, kou kaikuaana, a no kana mau keikikane, i lawelawe oia na'u ma ka oihana a ke kahuna.
28.5: A e lawe lakou i gula, a i lole uliuli, a i poni, a i ulaula, a i keokeo.
28.6: E hana lakou i ka epoda, he gula, a he lole uliuli, i poni, a ulaula, a he olona i hiloia, i humuhumuia e ka poe akamai.
28.7: E huiia kona mau apana poohiwi elua, ma kona mau kihi elua, a e pili no ia.
28.8: A o ke kaei o ka epoda maluna iho, hookahi no ano me ia, ma ka hana ana, he gula, he uliuli, he poni, a me ke olona i hiloia.
28.9: A e lawe hoi oe i elua pohaku onika, a e kahakaha maluna o laua i na inoa o na keiki a Iseraela.
28.10: Eono o lakou inoa ma kekahi pohaku, a o na inoa eono i koe, ma kekahi pohaku, e like me ko lakou hanau ana.
28.11: Me ka hana a ka mea kahakaha pohaku, o ke kahakaha ana o ka hoailona, pela oe e kahakaha ai i na pohaku elua, me na inoa o na keiki a Iseraela; e hana oe ia mau mea e kau maloko o na kawaha gula.
28.12: A e kau oe ia mau pohaku elua maluna o na poohiwi o ka epoda, i mau pohaku e hoomanao ai i na keiki a Iseraela; a e lawe no o Aarona i ko lakou inoa imua o Iehova, maluna o kona mau poohiwi elua, i mea e hoomanao ai.
28.13: E hana oe i mau kawaha gula:
28.14: A i elua kaula gula maikai ma na welau; e hana ia mau mea i mea e hookaawale ai, he kaula hilo, a e hoopaa i ua mau kaula la ma na kawaha.
28.15: A e hana oe i ka paleumauma o ka hooponopono ana; he hana na ka poe akamai, e like me ka hana ana i ka epoda, pela oe e hana'i: he gula, he uliuli, he poni, he ulaula, he olona i hiloia, pela oe e hana'i.
28.16: Eha ona mau aoao ahalike, a papalua hoi: hookahi kikoo kona loihi, a hookahi kikoo kona laula.
28.17: A e hoopiha oe ia mea, a piha i na pohaku, eha lalani pohaku: o ka lalani mua, he saredio, he topazo, he bareka, oia ka lalani mua.
28.18: A o ka lalani lua, he omaomao, he sapeiro, he daimana.
28.19: A o ka lalani kolu, he ligura, he agati, a he ametuseto.
28.20: A o ka lalani ha, he berulo, he onika, he iasepi: e hoopaaia ia mau mea iloko o ke gula, oia ko lakou mea e paa ai.
28.21: A ma ia mau pohaku no, na inoa o na keiki a Iseraela, he umikumamalua, e like me ko lakou inoa, me ke kahakaha ana o ka hoailona: o kela mea, keia mea ma kona inoa, e like me na ohana he umikumamalua.
28.22: A e hana oe ma ka paleumauma, i elua kaula ma na welau, he gula maikai i hiloia.
28.23: A e hana no hoi oe ma ka paleumauma, i elua apo gula, a e hookomo i na apo ma na welau elua o ka paleumauma.
28.24: A e hookomo oe i ua mau kaula hilo la elua, na kaula gula, iloko o na apo elua ma na welau o ka paleumauma.
28.25: A o kekahi mau welau elua o na kaula hilo elua, e hoopaa oe ia ma na kawaha, a e kau hoi maluna o na apana poohiwi elua o ka epoda, ma ke alo.
28.26: E hana no hoi oe i elua apo gula, a e hookomo oe ia i na welau elua o ka paleumauma, ma kona kae, ma ka aoao maloko o ka epoda.
28.27: A e hana oe i elua apo gula, a e hookomo ia ma na apana poohiwi elua o ka epoda malalo, ma ke alo hoi e ku pono ana i kona mau huina, maluna o ke kaei o ka epoda.
28.28: A e nakiki lakou i ka paleumauma ma kona mau apo a i na apo o ka epoda me ke kaula uliuli, i kau oia maluna o ke kaei o ka epoda, i hemo ole ai ka paleumauma, mai ka epoda aku.
28.29: A e lawe o Aarona i na inoa o na keiki a Iseraela ma ka paleumauma o ka hooponopono ma kona naau, i ka wa e hele aku ai ia i kahi kapu, i mea e hoomanao mau ai imua o Iehova.
28.30: A e kau oe iloko o ka paleumauma o ka hooponopono i ka Urima, a me ke Tumima, a e mau no laua ma ka naau o Aarona, ia ia e hele aku ai imua o Iehova. A lawe mau no o Aarona i ka hooponopono ana o na mamo a Iseraela, ma kona naau, imua o Iehova.
28.31: E hana oe i ka holoku o ka epoda, he uliuli wale no.
28.32: He puka no mawaenakonu ona maluna, a o ka pelupelu ana ma ke kae o ka puka, he mea i ulanaia, e like me ka puka o ka puliki koa nahae ole.
28.33: A ma kona mau lepa, e hana oe i mau pomeraite, he uliuli, he poni, he ulaula, a puni kona lepa, a he mau bele gula mawaena o lakou a puni:
28.34: He bele gula, a me ka pomeraite, a he bele gula, a me ka pomeraite, ma ka lepa o ka holoku a puni.
28.35: A maluna ia o Aarona e lawelawe ai; a e loheia kona kani ana, i kona wa e hele aku ai i kahi kapu, imua o Iehova, a i kona wa e puka aku ai iwaho, i ole ia e make.
28.36: E hana hoi oe i papa gula maikai, a e kahakaha hoi i ke kahakaha ana o ka hoailona, UA LAA NO IEHOVA.
28.37: A e hoopaa oe ia mea me ke kaula uliuli, i paa ia maluna o ka papale hainika, ma ke alo o ka papale ia e kau ai.
28.38: A e kauia ia mea ma ka lae o Aarona, i lawe o Aarona i ka hewa o na mea laa, na mea a na mamo a Iseraela e hoolaa ai, i ko lakou mau makana laa a pau: a e mau no ia ma kona lae, i aponoia'i lakou imua o Iehova.
28.39: E hoonionio oe i ka palule olona, a e hana oe i ka papale hainika, he olona; a e hana oe i ke kaei, he humuhumu onionio.
28.40: E hana no hoi oe i mau palule no na keikikane a Aarona, a e hana hoi i mau kaei no lakou; e hana no hoi i mau papale no lakou, i mea nani, a i mea maikai.
28.41: A e kau no oe ia mau mea maluna o Aarona o kou kaikuaana, a me kana mau keikikane pu me ia; a e poni oe ia lakou, a e hoolaa ia lakou, a e hookahuna ia lakou, i lawelawe lakou na'u ma ka oihana a ke kahuna.
28.42: E hana oe i wawae olona e uhi ai i ko lakou wahi huna; mai ka puhaka a i ka uha ka loihi:
28.43: Maluna o Aarona ia mea, a maluna o kana mau keikikane, ia lakou e hele mai ai iloko o ka halelewa o ka ahakanaka, a ia lakou e hookokoke mai ai i ke kuahu, e lawelawe ma kahi kapu, i kau ole ai ka hewa maluna o lakou a make. He kanawai mau loa ia nona, a no kana poe mama mahope ona.

29.1: EIA ka mea au e hana'i ia lakou, e hoolaa ia lakou, e lawelawe na'u ma ka oihana kahuna. E lawe oe i hookahi bipi opiopio, a i elua hipakane kina ole,
29.2: A i berena hu ole, a i mau popoberena hu ole i miko i ka aila, a me na papa hu ole i hamoia i ka aila: he palaoa o ka huita kau e hana'i ia mau mea.
29.3: A e uhao oe ia mau mea iloko o ka hinai hookahi, a e lawe mai oe ia mau mea ma ka hinai, me ka bipi a me na hipakane elua.
29.4: A e kai mai oe ia Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane, a i ka puka o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, a e holoi ia lakou i ka wai.
29.5: A lawe oe i na aahu, a e hookomo i ka palule maluna o Aarona, a i ka holoku o ka epoda, a me ka epoda, a me ka paleumauma, a e kaei ia ia i ke kaei o ka epoda;
29.6: A e kau oe i ka papale hainaka maluna o kona poo, a e kau hoi i ka lei kapu, maluna o ka papale.
29.7: Alaila e lawe oe i ka aila poni, a e ninini iho maluna o kona poo, a e poni hoi ia ia.
29.8: A e kai mai hoi oe i kana mau keikikane, a e hookomo i na palule maluna o lakou.
29.9: A e kaei ia lakou i na kaei, ia Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane pu, a e nakiikii hoi i na papale maluna o lakou; a o ka oihana a ke kahuna, na lakou no, he kanawai mau loa ia: a e hoolaa oe ia Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane.
29.10: E kai mai hoi oe i bipi imua o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka; a e kau o Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane i ko lakou mau lima ma ke poo o ka bipi.
29.11: A e pepehi oe i ka bipi imua o Iehova, ma ka puka o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka.
29.12: A e lawe oe i kekahi koko o ka bipi, a e kau ma na pepeiao o ke kuahu me kou manamana lima, a e ninini iho i ke koko a pau ma ke kumu o ke kuahu.
29.13: E lawe hoi oe i ke kaikea a pau e wahi ana i na naau, a me ke aa maluna o ke ake, a me na konahua elua, a me ke kaikea e pili ana, a e puhi ia mau mea i ke ahi maluna o ke kuahu.
29.14: Aka, o ka io o ka bipi, a me kona ili, a me kona lepo, e puhi oe ia i ke ahi, mawaho o ke kahua hoomoana. He mohai hala ia.
29.15: E lawe hoi oe i hookahi hipakane, a e kau no o Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane i ko lakou mau lima ma ke poo o ka hipa.
29.16: A e pepehi oe i ka hipa, a e lawe i kona koko, a e kapii iho maluna iho o ke kuahu a puni.
29.17: A e oki liilii oe i ka hipa, a e holoi i ko loko ona, a me kona mau wawae, a e hoolilo i kona mau apana, a me kona poo.
29.18: A e puhi oe i ka hipa a pau maluna o ke kuahu; he mohaikuni ia na Iehova, he mea ala, i puhiia na Iehova.
29.19: E lawe no hoi oe i kekahi hipakane, a e kau no o Aarona a me kana mau keikikane i na lima o lakou ma ke poo o ka hipa.
29.20: Alaila, e pepehi oe i ka hipa, a e lawe i kekahi o kona koko, a e kau ma ka piko o ka pepeiao akau o Aarona, a ma ka piko o ka pepeiao akau o kana mau keikikane, a ma ka manamana nui o ko lakou lima akau, a ma ka manamana nui o ko lakou wawae akau, a e kapii hoi i ke koko maluna o ke kuahu a puni.
29.21: A e lawe oe i kekahi o ke koko ma ke kuahu, a me kahi o ka aila poni, a e kapii maluna o Aarona, a maluna o kona kahiko, a maluna o kana mau keikikane, a maluna o ke kahiko o kana mau keikikane pu me ia. A e hoolaaia oia, a me kona kahiko, a o kana mau keikikane, a me ke kahiko o kana mau keikikane pu me ia.
29.22: A e lawe hoi oe i ko ka hipa, i ke kelekele, a me ka huelo a me ke kaikea e wahi ana i na naau, a me ke aa maluna o ke ake, a me na konahua elua a me ke kaikea e pili ana, a me ka uha mua akau, no ka mea, he hipa ia e hoolaa ai:
29.23: A i hookahi popo berena, a i hookahi papa berena, he berena me ka aila, a hookahi papa mailoko mai o ka hinai berena hu ole, ka mea imua o Iehova.
29.24: A e haawi oe ia mau mea a pau iloko o na lima o Aarona, a iloko o na lima a kana mau keikikane, a e hoali lakou i mohai hoali imua o Iehova.
29.25: A e lawe oe ia mau mea mai ko lakou lima, a e puhi maluna o ke kuahu, i mohai kuni, i mea ala imua o Iehova; he mohai ahi ia na Iehova.
29.26: E lawe hoi oe i ka umauma o ka hipa o ko Aarona hoolaaia, a e hoali ae, i mohai hoali imua o Iehova, oia hoi kau apana.
29.27: A e hoolaa oe i ka umauma o ka mohai hoali, a me ka uha mua o ka mohai kaikai, ka mea i hoaliia, a kaikaiia hoi, o ka hipakane o ka hoolaa ana, ka mea no Aarona, a no kana mau keikikane;
29.28: A e lilo ia na Aarona, a na kana mau keikikane, mai na mamo a Iseraela ae, he kanawai mau loa ia; no ka mea, he mohai kaikai ia: a e lilo ia i mohai kaikai, mai na mamo a Iseraela ae, i alana hoi no na mohai hoomalu o ko lakou mohai kaikai no Iehova.
29.29: A o na kahiko laa o Aarona, na kana mau keikikane ia mahope ona; i poniia lakou maloko o ia mau mea, a hoolaaia maloko olaila.
29.30: A o ke keiki e lilo ana i kahuna ma kona hakahaka, nana no e hookomo ia mau mea i ehiku la, i kona manawa e hele mai ai iloko o ka helelewa o ke anaina kanaka, e lawelawe ma kahi hoano.
29.31: A e lawe oe i ka hipakane o ka hoolaa ana, a e hoolapalapa i kona io maloko o kahi hoano.
29.32: A e ai no o Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane i ka io o ka hipakane, a me ka berena maloko o ka hinai, ma ka puka o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka.
29.33: A e ai no lakou ia mau mea i huikalaia'i, e hookahuna, a e hoolaa ia lakou: aole e ai ka malihini, no ka mea, ua laa ia mau mea.
29.34: A ina e koe iho kekahi io o ka hoolaa ana, a kekahi berena paha, a kakahiaka, alaila e puhi oe i ke koena i ke ahi; aole ia e aiia, no ka mea, ua laa ia.
29.35: A pela oe e hana'i ia Aarona, a i kana mau keikikane, e like me na mea a pau a'u i kauoha aku ai ia oe, i ehiku la e hoolaa ai oe ia lakou.
29.36: A e kaumaha oe i kela la i keia la, i bipi, he mohai hala, i mea e kalahala ai: a e hoomaemae oe i ke kuahu, i ka wa au e hookalahala ai nona, a e poni oe ia mea, a e hoolaa hoi.
29.37: Ehiku la e kalahala'i oe no ke kuahu, a e hoolaa ia men; a e lilo ia i kuahu laa loa. E laa no na mea a pau i pa mai i ke kuahu.
29.38: Eia hoi ka mea au e kaumaha'i maluna o ke kuahu a mau i kela la i keia la, elua keikihipa o ka makahiki hookahi.
29.39: E kaumaha oe i hookahi keikihipa i ke kakahiaka, a o kekahi keikihipa kau e kaumaha ai i ke ahiahi.
29.40: Me ke keikihipa hookahi, he hapaumi o ka epa palaoa, i huiia me ka hapaha o ka hina aila i kuiia; a me ka hapaha o ka hina waina, i mea mohai inu.
29.41: E kaumaha hoi oe i kekahi keikihipa i ke ahiahi, a e hana aku hoi ia mea, e like me ka mohai makana o ke kakahiaka, a e like hoi me kona mohai inu, i mea ala, he mohai ahi hoi ia no Iehova.
29.42: He mohaikuni mau ia no ko oukou hanauna, ma ka puka o ka halelewa o ke anaina, imua o Iehova; kahi a'u e halawai ai me oe, e kamailio pu me oe malaila.
29.43: A malaila wau e halawai ai me na mamo a Iseraela, a e hoolaaia mai ai, e ko'u nani.
29.44: A e hoolaa no wau i ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, a me ke kuahu: e hoolaa no hoi au ia Aarona. a me kana mau keikikane, e lawelawe no'u ma ka oihana kahuna.
29.45: A e noho no wau iwaena konu o na mamo a Iseraela, a owau auanei ko lakou Akua.
29.46: A e ike auanei lakou, owau no Iehova, ko lakou Akua, ka mea i lawe mai ia lakou, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai, i noho wau iwaena o lakou. Owau, o Iehova no ko lakou Akua.

30.1: E HANA oe i kuahu, i wahi e puhi ai i ka mea ala. E hana oe ia mea i ka laau sitima.
30.2: Hookahi kubita kona loihi, a he kubita hoi kona laula; e hanaia na aoao ahalike, a elua kubita kona kiekie, oia mea hookahi me na pepeiao ona.
30.3: A e uhi oe ia mea i ke gula maikai, o ko luna, a me na aoao ona a puni, a me kona mau pepeiao, a e hana oe i lei gula a puni ia mea.
30.4: A e hana oe i mau apo gula nona elua, malalo iho o kona lei; ma kona mau kihi, ma na aoao elua ona kau e hana'i ia mea; i mau wahi ia no na auamo e lawe ai i ke kuahu.
30.5: A e hana oe i na auamo, he laau sitima, a e wahi ia mau mea i ke gula.
30.6: A e waiho oe ia mea imua o ka paku e kau ana imua o ka pahu hoike, imua hoi o ka noho aloha e kau ana maluna o ka pahu kanawai, kahi a'u e halawai ai me oe.
30.7: A e puhi o Aarona maluna olaila i mea ala maikai, i kela kakahiaka, keia kakahiaka: i kona wa e koli ai i na kukui, e puhi oia i ka mea ala maluna olaila.
30.8: A i ka wa e hoa ai o Aarona i na kukui i ke ahiahi, e puhi no oia i ka mea ala maluna olaila, he mea ala hoomau no ko oukou mau hanauna a pau.
30.9: Mai Kaumaha oe i ka mea ala e maluna olaila, aole hoi he mohaikuni, aole hoi he mohai makana, mai ninini hoi i ka mohai inu maluna olaila.
30.10: A maluna o kona mau pepeiao, e kalahala ai o Aarona, i hookahi kalahala ana o ka makahiki, me ke koko o ka mohai hala o ke kalahala ana. E kalahala no oia maluna olaila, i hookahi no hana ana o ka makahiki no ko oukou hanauna; ua laa loa ia no Iehova.
30.11: Olelo mai la o Iehova ia Mose, i mai la,
30.12: I ka wa e helu ai oe i na mamo a Iseraela, i ka poe e heluia'i, alaila, e haawi no kela kanaka, keia kanaka i uku ia Iehova, no kona uhane, i ka wa au e helu ai ia lakou, i ole ai ka mai ahulau iwaena o lakou, i kou wa e helu ai ia lakou.
30.13: Eia ka lakou e haawi mai ai, o kela mea keia mea e hele ae ranwaena o ka poe i heluia, he hapalua o ka sekela, ma ka sekela o ke keenakapu, (he iwakalua gera hookahi ia sekela,) a he hapalua o ka sekela, oia ka haawina ia Iehova.
30.14: O kela mea keia mea e hele ae iwaena o ka poe i heluia, mai ka iwakalua o ka makahiki a keu aku, a haawi no oia i haawina ia Iehova.
30.15: Aole hookeu aku ka mea waiwai, aole hoi ka mea hune e hoemi iho i ka hapalua o ka sekela i ko lakou haawi ana ia Iehova, e kalahala ai no ko oukou uhane.
30.16: A e lawe oe i ke kala kalahala o na mamo a Iseraela, a e haawi ia mea no ka hana o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, i lilo ia i mea paipai manao no na mamo a Iseraela imua o Iehova, i mea hoi e kalahala'i no ko oukou poe uhane.
30.17: Olelo mai la o Iehova ia Mose, i mai la,
30.18: E hana no oe i ipu auau keleawe, a o kona kumu hoi he keleawe, i wahi e holoi ai. A e waiho oe ia mea mawaena o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, a me ke kuahu, a e ninini oe i ka wai maloko.
30.19: No ka mea, malaila no e holoi ai o Aarona, a me kana mau keiki i ko lakou mau lima, a me ko lakou mau wawae.
30.20: A hele lakou iloko o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, alaila, e holoi lakou me ka wai, i ole ai lakou e make; a i ka manawa hoi e hookokoke mai ai lakou i ke kuahu e lawelawe ai, e puhi i mohai ahi no Iehova:
30.21: I holoi lakou i ko lakou mau lima, a me ko lakou mau wawae, i ole ai lakou e make. He kanawai mau loa ia no lakou; nona, a no kana poe mamo ma ko lakou hanauna.
30.22: Olelo mai no hoi o Iehova ia Mose, i mai la,
30.23: E lawe oe nou i mau hua ala nui, i mura maikai, elima haneri sekela, a i kinemona ikaika, he hapalua, elua hoi haneri sekela, a me ke kanalima, a i oheala, elua haneri a me ke kanalima sekela.
30.24: A i kida, elima haneri sekela, ma ka sekela o ke keenakapu, a i hookahi hina aila oliva:
30.25: A e hana oe ia i aila poni hoano, he mea poni i huiia ma ke ano o ka hana ana i na mea ala. E lilo ia i aila poni hoano.
30.26: A me ia no oe e poni ai i ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, a me ka pahu o ke kanawai,
30.27: A me ka papaaina, a me kona mau oihana a pau, a me ka ipukukui, a me kona mau oihana a pau, a me ke kuahu no ka mea ala,
30.28: A me ke kuahu no ka mohaikuni, a me kona mau oihana a pau, a me ka ipu auau, a me kona kumu.
30.29: A e hoolaa oe ia mau mea, i laa loa lakou: o na mea a pau e pili ana me ia mau mea, e laa no lakou.
30.30: A e poni no hoi oe ia Aarona, a me kana mau keikikane, a e hoolaa ia lakou, i lawelawe lakou na'u ma ka oihana kahuna.
30.31: A e olelo aku oe i na mamo a Iseraela, e i aku, He aila poni hoano keia no'u, ma ko oukou mau hanauna.
30.32: Aole ia e nininiia maluna o ka io o ke kanaka, mai hana hoi oe i kekahi mea hamo like, ma ke ano hookahi me ia; ua laa ia, a e laa auanei ia no oukou.
30.33: O ka mea hana i mea ala e like me ia, a o ka mea kau ia mea maluna o ka malihini, e okiia oia mai kona poe kanaka aku.
30.34: I mai la o Iehova ia Mose, E lawe oe i mea ala nou, i natapa, i onika, a i metopio, ia mau mea ala, a me ka libano, e like no ke kaumaha o ia mau mea a pau.
30.35: A e hana oe he mea ala, i laau poni hoi, e like me ka hana ana i na mea ala, i hanaia a miko, maikai, a laa hoi.
30.36: A e kui oe i kekahi o ia mea a wali loa, a e kau aku imua o ke kanawai, maloko o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, kahi a'u e halawai ai me oe. E laa loa auanei ia no oukou.
30.37: A o ka mea ala au e hana'i, mai hana oukou i mea e like ai no oukou; e laa no ia ia oe no Iehova.
30.38: O ka mea hana e like me ia, i mea e honi ai, e okiia no ia, mai kona poe kanaka aku.

31.1: OLELO mai o Iehova ia Mose, i mai la,
31.2: E nana hoi, ua kahea aku au ma ka inoa, ia Bezalela, i ke keiki a Uri, i ka keiki a Hura, no ka ohana a Iuda.
31.3: A ua hoopiha au ia ia i ka uhane o ke Akua, ma ke akamai, ma ka naauao, ma ka ike, a ma ka hana ana i na mea a pau,
31.4: E imi i na mea akamai, e hana hoi ma ke gala, a ma ke kala, a ma ke keleawe,
31.5: A i ke okioki pohaku, i mea kapili: a i ke kalai ana i ka laau e hana hoi i na hana a pau.
31.6: A owau, aia hoi, ua haawi no wau ia Aholiaba nona, i ke keiki a Ahisamaka, no ka ohana a Dana; a ua haawi no wau i ke akamai maloko o ka naau o ka poe a pau i naauao, i hana lakou i na mea a pau a'u i kauoha aku at ia oe:
31.7: I ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, a me ka pahu kanawai, a me ka noho aloha maluna iho, a me ka oihana a pau o ka halelewa,
31.8: A me ka papaaina, a me kona oihana, a me ka ipukukui, me kona oihana a pau, a me ke kuahu no ka mea ala,
31.9: A me ke kuahu no ka mohaikuni a me kona oihana a pau, a me ka ipu auau, a me kona kumu,
31.10: A me na lole hana, a me na kahiko laa no Aarona ke kahuna, a me na kahiko no kana mau keikikane e lawelawe ai ma ka oihana kahuna,
31.11: A me ka aila poni, a mo ka mea ala maikai no kahi laa; e like me na mea a pau a'u i kauoha aku ai ia oe, pela laua e hana'i.
31.12: Olelo mai la o Iehova ia Mose, i mai la,
31.13: E olelo aku oe i na mamo a Iseraela, e i aku, E malama io oukou i ko'u mau sabati, no ka mea, he hoailona ia mawaena o'u a me oukou, i ko oukou mau hanauna; i ike hoi oukou, owau no Iehova, ka mea hoolaa ia oukou.
31.14: Nolaila oukou e malama'i i ka sabati; no ka mea, ua hoanoia ia no oukou, O kela mea keia mea hoohaumia ia la, e oiaio no e pepehiia oia: no ka mea, o ka mea hana i ka hana ia la, e okiia kela kanaka, mai kona poe kanaka aku.
31.15: Eono la e hanain'i ka hana, aka o ka hiku, he sabati ia e hoomaha'i, he mea laa no Iehova, o ka mea hana i kekahi hana i ka sabati, e oiaio no e pepehiia oia.
31.16: A e malama na mamo a Iseraela i ka sabati e hooponopono i ka sabati, i ko lakou hanauna, i berita mau loa.
31.17: He hoailona mau loa ia mawaena o'u a me na mamo a Iseraela; no ka mea, i na la eono i hana'i o Iehova i ka lani, a me ka honua, a i ka hiku o ka la, hoomaha oia, a oluolu iho la,
31.18: A i kona hoopau ana i ke kamailio me Mose, maluna o ka mauna o Sinai, haawi mai la oia ia ia i elua papa kanawai he mau papa pohaku, ua kahakahaia e ka lima o ke Akua.

32.1: A IKE aku la na kanaka i ko Mose hookaulua ana i ka iho mai, mai ka mauna mai, akoakoa iho la na kanaka io Aarona la, olelo ae la ia ia, E ku oe, e hana i akua no kakou, i mea hele mamua o kakou: no ka mea, o ua Mose la, ke kanaka nana kakou i alakai mai nei, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai; aole kakou ike i kona wahi i lilo aku ai.
32.2: I mai la o Aarona ia lakou, E uhai oukou i na apo gula pepeiao, i na mea iloko o na pepeiao o ka oukou wahine, a me ka oukou keikikane, a me ka oukou kaikamahine, a e lawe mai io'u nei.
32.3: Uhai iho la na kanaka a pau i na gula pepeiao, i na mea iloko o ko lakou pepeiao, a lawe mai io Aarona la.
32.4: Lawe iho la ia, mai ko lakou lima aku, a koli iho la ia mea i ke kila, a hana ae la i bipi keiki i hooheheeia; a olelo iho la lakou, Eia kou akua, e ka Iseraela, nana oe i lawe mai nei, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai.
32.5: A ike aku la o Aarona, hana iho la ia i kuahu imua i ke alo o ia mai; hea aku la o Aarona, i aku la, E, I apopo, he ahaaina na Iehova.
32.6: A ia la iho, ala koke ae la lakou, a mohai aku la i mohaikuni, a lawe mai no hoi i mohaihoomalu; a noho iho la na kanaka e ai, a e inu, a ku ae la iluna e paani.
32.7: I mai la o Iehova ia Mose, O hele oe, e iho ilalo; ua hana hewa kou poe kanaka au i lawe mai ai, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai.
32.8: Ua huli koke ae lakou, mai ke ala aku a'u i kauoha aku ai ia lakou; ua hana lakou i bipi keiki i hooheheeia no lakou, ua hoomana lakou ia mea, a ua mohai hoi lakou ia ia, me ka i ana aku, E ka Iseraela e, eia kou akua, nana oe i lawe mai nei, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai.
32.9: I mai la o Iehova ia Mose, Ua ike no au i keia poe kanaka, aia hoi, he poe kanaka a-i oolea:
32.10: Ano hoi, e ae mai oe ia'u, i wela loa ko'u huhu ia lakou, i hoopau wau ia lakou; a na'u no e hana aku ia oe i lahuikanaka nui.
32.11: Nonoi aku la o Mose ma ke alo o Iehova, o kona Akua, i aku la, E Iehova, no ke aha la i wela ai kou huhu i kou poe kanaka au i lawe mai ai, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai, me ka mana nui, a me ka lima ikaika?
32.12: No ke aha la e olelo mai ai ko Aigupita, me ka i ana mai, No ka hewa i lawe mai ai oia ia lakou, e pepehi ia lakou ma na mauna, a e luku aku ia lakou, mai ka maka aku o ka honua? E maliu mai oe mai ka wela mai o kou huhu, a e aloha mai oe no ka hewa e hiki mai ana i kou poe kanaka.
32.13: E hoomanao oe ia Aberahama, ia Isaaka, ia Iseraela, i kau mau kauwa, i kou hoohiki ana ia lakou ma ou iho; i kau olelo ana mai ia lakou, E hoonui ana au i ka oukou ohana e like me na hoku o ka lani; a o keia aina a pau a'u i olelo ai, na'u no e haawi aku no ka oukou poe mamo, a e noho mau loa lakou ma ia aina.
32.14: Maliu mai la no o Iehova mai ka hoino mai ana i manao ai e hana mai i kona poe kanaka.
32.15: Huli mai la o Mose, a iho mai la, mai ka mauna mai, aia hoi, maloko o kona lima na pohaku papa kanawai elua: ua palapalaia na papa ma na aoao elua, ua palapalaia no ma kahi aoao, a ma kahi aoao.
32.16: O ia mau papa ka ke Akua i hana'i, a o ka palapala, na ke Akua ka palapala, ua kahakahaia maloko o na papa.
32.17: A lohe o Iosua i ka walaau o kanaka i ko lakou uwauwa ana, i ae la ia ia Mose, He walaau kaua ka ma kahi e hoomoana'i.
32.18: I mai la kela, Aole ia he leo no ka poe uwauwa lanakila, aole hoi ka leo o ka poe uwe i ke pio ana; aka o ka walaau mele ka'u e lohe nei.
32.19: A kokoke ia i hiki i kahi o lakou i hoomoana'i, ike aku la ia i ka bipi keiki, a me ka haa ana: ulu puni iho la ko Mose huhu, kiola aku la ia i na papa, mai kona lima aku, a naha iho la laua malalo iho o ka mauna.
32.20: Lawe iho la ia i ka bipi keiki a lakou i hana'i, a puhi aku la i ke ahi, a hoowali iho la a okaoka, a lulu aku la ia maluna o ka wai, a hoohainu aku la i na mamo a Iseraela i ka wai.
32.21: I aku la o Mose ia Aarona, Heaha ka mea a keia poe kanaka i hana'i ia oe, i hooili mai ai oe i keia hewa nui maluna o lakou.
32.22: I mai la o Aarona, Mai ulu puni mai ka huhu o kuu haku, ua ike no oe i ka poe kanaka, na paa lakou ma ke kolohe.
32.23: No ka mea, olelo mai lakou ia'u, E hana oe i na akua no kakou, e hele aku imua o kakou; no ka mea, o ua Mose nei, ke kanaka nana kakou i lawe mai nei, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai, aole kakou i ike i kona wahi i lilo aku ai.
32.24: I aku la au ia lakou, O ka mea ia ia kekahi gula, e uhai oia ia mea. Haawi mai no hoi lakou ia'u: alaila hahao aku la au ia mea iloko o ke ahi, a puka mai la mawaho ua bipi keiki nei.
32.25: A ike mai la o Mose i na kanaka, ua haunaele; (no ka mea, ua hoohaunaele o Aarona ia lakou i ka lukuia imua o ko lakou poe enemi:)
32.26: Alaila ku mai la o Mose ma ka puka o kahi a lakou i hoomoana'i, i mai la, Owai ka mea ma ko Iehova aoao? e hele mai ia io'u nei. A akoakoa pu mai la na mamo a pau a Levi io na la.
32.27: I mai la ia ia lakou, Ke i mai nei o Iehova o ke Akua o Iseraela penei, E kau na kanaka a pau i na pahikaua a lakou ma ko lakou aoao, e hele ae lakou a hoi mai, ma kela ipuka a keia ipuka o kahi hoomoana, a e pepehi ke kanaka i kona hoahanau, a o ke kanaka i kona makamaka, a o ke kanaka i kona hoalauna.
32.28: Hana iho la na mamo a Levi e like me ka olelo a Mose: a haule iho la ia lakou ia la na kanaka ekolu paha tausani.
32.29: No ka mea, ua olelo mai o Mose, E hoolaa oukou ia oukou iho no Iehova i keia la, o ke kanaka maluna o kana keiki a maluna o kona hoahanau; i hoomaikai mai kela ia oukou i keia la.
32.30: A ia la iho, i mai la o Mose i na kanaka, Ua lawehala loa oukou; ke pii aku nei no hoi au io Iehova la; e hana paha wau i mea e kalaia mai ai ko oukou hewa.
32.31: Hoi aku la o Mose io Iehova la, i aku la, Auwe hoi, ua lawehala loa keia poe kanaka, a ua hana i akua gula no lakou.
32.32: Ano hoi, ina paha e kala mai oe i ko lakou hewa?; aka, i ole, ke nonoi aku nei au ia oe e holoi mai oe ia'u, mai ka buke au i palapala ai.
32.33: I mai la o Iehova ia Mose, O ka mea i lawehala i ka'u, e holoi aku au ia ia, mai ka'u buke aku.
32.34: No ia mea, o hele oe, e alakai ia poe kanaka i kahi a'u i olelo ai ia oe: aia hoi, e hele no ko'u anela mamua ou, aka hoi, i ko'u la e hoopai ai, e hoopai aku au i ko lakou hewa maluna o lakou.
32.35: Hahau mai la Iehova i na kanaka no ka lakou hana ana i ka bipi keiki a Aarona i hana'i.

33.1: OLELO mai la o Iehova ia Mose, o hele, e pii aku, o oe a me na kanaka au i alakai mai nei, mai ka aina o Aigupita mai, a i ka aina a'u i hoohiki ai ia Aberahama, a ia Isaaka, a ia Iakoba, i ka i ana iho, Ke haawi nei au ia na kau poe mamo.
33.2: A e hoouna aku au i ko'u anela imua ou; a na'u no e kipaku aku i ka Kanaana, i ka Amora, i ka Heta, i ka Pereza, i ka Heva, a i ka Iebusa;
33.3: A i ka aina e kahe ana o ka waiu a me ka mele; no ka mea, aole au e pii aku iwaena ou, no ka mea, he poe kanaka a-i oolea oukou; o hoopau auanei au ia oe ma ke ala.
33.4: A lohe na kanaka i keia olelo o ka hewa, uwe iho la lakou, aohe kanaka i hookomo i kona kahiko ana.
33.5: No ka mea, ua olelo mai o Iehova ia Mose, E i aku oe i na mamo a Iseraela, He poe kanaka a-i oolea oukou: i ka minute hookahi, e pii aku no au iwaena konu ou, a e hoopau ia oe, Nolaila, e wehe oe i kou kahiko ana mai ou aku la, i ike au i ka mea e hana aku ai ia oe.
33.6: A wehe na mamo a Iseraela i ko lakou kahiko ana, ma ka mauna o Horeba.
33.7: A lawe ae la o Mose i ka halelewa, a kukulu iho la mawaho o kahi e hoomoana'i, ma kahi mamao aku o ke kahua i hoomoana'i; a kapa ae la oia ia mea, o ka Halelewa o ke anaina kanaka. A o kela mea keia mea i imi ia Iehova, hele aku la ia iwaho i ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, ka mea mawaho o kahi i hoomoana'i.
33.8: A i ka hele ana aku o Mose i ka halelewa, ala ae la na kanaka a pau iluna, a ku no kela kanaka keia kanaka ma ka puka o kona halelewa, a nana aku la mahope o Mose, a hala ia iloko o ka halelewa.
33.9: A i ko Mose komo ana iloko o ka halelewa, iho mai la ke kia ao, a ku ma ka puka o ka halelewa, a kamailio mai la [o Iehova] me Mose.
33.10: A ike ae la na kanaka a pau i ke kia ao e ku ana ma ka puka o ka halelewa, a ku ae la na Kanaka a pau iluna, a hoomana aku la, o kela kanaka keia kanaka ma ka puka o kona halelewa.
33.11: A kamailio mai la o Iehova ia Mose, he maka no he maka, e like me ke kamailio ana o ke kanaka me kona hoa. A hoi aku la ia iloko o kahi e hoomoana'i, a me kana kauwa, o Iosua, ke keiki a Nuna, he kanaka opiopio; aka, aole ia i hele iwaho o ka halelewa.
33.12: I aku la o Mose ia Iehova, E nana hoi, ke olelo mai nei oe ia'u, E kai mai oe i keia poe kanaka; aole nae oe i hoike mai ia'u i ka mea au e hoouna pu ai me au. Aka, na olelo mai no, Ua ike no wau ia oe ma ka inoa, a e loaa ia oe ka lokomaikaiia i ko'u mau maka.
33.13: Nolaila, ke nonoi aku nei au ia oe, ina i loaa ia'u ka lokomaikaiia i kou mau maka, e hoike mai oe ia'u i kou aoao, i ike aku au ia oe, i loaa ia'u ka lokomaikaiia i kou mau maka: a e hoomanao hoi, o kou aupuni no keia poe kanaka.
33.14: I mai la keia, E hele pa ne ko'u maka, a na'u no oe e hoomaha aku.
33.15: I aka la keia, I ole e hele pu kou maka, mai lawe aku oe ia makou.
33.16: Mahea la e ikeia'i ua loaa ia'u a me kou poe kanaka ka lokomaikaiia i kou maka? Aole anei ma kou hele pu ana me makou? A pela makou e hookaawaleia'i, owau a me ko'u poe kanaka, mai na kanaka e aka a pau loa e noho ana maluna o ka honua.
33.17: Olelo mai la o Iehova, ia Mose, E hana no hoi au i keia mea au i olelo mai ai; no ka mea, ua loaa ia oe ka lokomaikaiia i ko'u maka, a ua ike aka au ia oe ma ka inoa.
33.18: A i aku la keia, Ke nonoi aku nei au ia oe, e hoike mai oe i kou nani ia'u.
33.19: Olelo mai la ia, E hoohele au i ko'u maikai a pau imua o kou maka, a e hea aku au i ka inoa o Iehova imua o kou maka; a e lokomaikai aka au i ka mea a'u e manao ai e lokomaikai aku, a e aloha aku au i ka mea a'u e manao ai e aloha aka.
33.20: A i mai la ia, Aole hiki ia oe ke ike mai i ko'u maka; no ka mea, aohe kanaka e ike mai ia'u, a ola.
33.21: A i mai la o Iehova, Aia kahi e kokoke ana ia'u, a e ku no oe maluna o ka pohaku.
33.22: A i ka wa e hele ae ko'u nani, e hookomo no wau ia oe iloko o ka mauae o ka pohaku, a e uhi aku au ia oe i ko'u lima, ia'u e hele ana'e.
33.23: A e lawe aku au i ko'u lima, a e ike mai oe i ko'u kua; aka, aole e ikeia ko'u maka.

34.1: OLELO mai la o Iehova ia Mose, E kalai oe i mau pohaku papa elua nou, e like me na mea mamua; a na'u no e palapala maluna o ua mau papa la i na olelo i kauia'i ma na papa mua au i wahi ai.
34.2: E hoomakaukau oe no ke kakahiaka, a i ke kakahiaka e pii mai oe i ka mauna nei i Sinai, a e hoike mai oe ia oe iho ia'u ilaila ma ke poo o ka mauna.
34.3: Mai hele pu mai kekahi kanaka me oe, aole hoi e ikea kekahi kanaka ma ka mauna a pau; aole hoi e ai na hipa a me na holoholona ma ke alo o ia mauna.
34.4: Kalai iho la ia i na pohaku papa elua e like me na mea mamua; a ala ae la o Mose i kakahiaka nui, a pii aka la i ka mauna i Sinai, e like me ke kauoha ana mai o Iehova ia ia, a lawe aku la maloko o kona lima i ua mau pohaku papa la elua.
34.5: Iho mai la o Iehova maloko o ke ao, a ku pu me ia ilaila, a hai mai la i ka inoa o Iehova.
34.6: Hele ae la o Iehova mamua e kona alo, hai mai la ia, O Iehova, o Iehova, ke Akua lokomaikai, a manawalea, a ahonui, ua nui kona maikai a me ka oiaio.
34.7: Ke malama nei no i ka lokomaikai no na lehulehu, a me ke kala mai i ka ino a me ka hala a me ka hewa, aole hoi e hoapono loa, e uku ana no i ka ka makua hala i ke keiki, a me na keiki a na keiki, a hiki aku i ke kuakahi a me ke kualua.
34.8: Wikiwiki ae la o Mose e kulou i kona poo ilalo i ka honoa a hoomana aku la.
34.9: I aku la ia, A ina i loaa ia'u ka lokomaikaiia mai imua ou, e ka Haku e, ke nonoi aku nei au e hele pa aku ko'u Haku me makou: (he poe kanaka a-i eolea nae keia;) a e kala mai oe i ko makou hala me ko makou hewa, a e lawe oe ia makou i hooilina nou.
34.10: I mai la kela, Aia hoi, ke hana nei au i berita; a e hana no wau i na mea kupanaha mamua o kou poe kanaka a pau, aole i hanaia kekahi mea e like ai ma ka honua a pau, aole ma kekahi aina; a e ike auanei na kanaka a pau o kou wahi i ka hana a Iehova: he mea weliweli kela mea a'u e hana aku ai ia oe.
34.11: E malama hoi oe i ka mea a'u e kauoha aku ai ia oe i keia la. Aia hoi, e kipaku ana au imua ou, i ka Amora, a me ka Kanaaua, a me ka Heta, a me ka Periza, a me ka Heva, a me ka Iebusa.
34.12: E malama oe ia oe, o hana auanei oe i berita me ka poe e uoho ana i ka aina, kahi au e hele ai, o lilo ia i upiki iwaena o oukou.
34.13: Aka, e hoopau oukou i ko lakou mau kuahu, a e wawahi i ko lakou kii, a e kua ilalo i ko lakou nlulaau.
34.14: No ka mea, mai hoomana oe i kekahi akua e, no ka mea, o Iehova, nona ka inoa o Lili, he Akua lili ia;
34.15: O hana oe i berita me na kanaka o ka aina, a hele moe kolohe lakou mamuli o ko lakou mau akua, a mohai aku na ko lakou mau akua, a hea mai ia oe, a ai oe i kana mohai.
34.16: A lawe paha oe i ka lakou kaikamahine na ka oukou keikikane; a hele moe kolohe ka lakou kaikamahine mamuli o ko lakou poe akua, a hoomoe kolohe lakou i ka oukou keikikane mamuli o ko lakou poe akua.
34.17: Mai hana oe i akua hooheheeia nou.
34.18: E malama oe i ka ahaaina o ka berena huole. Ehiku la kau e ai ai i ka berena huole, me a'u i kauoha aku ai ia oe, i ka vra o ka malama o Abiba; no ka mea, i ka malama o Abiba i puka mai ai oe mawaho mai o Aigupita.
34.19: O na mea a pau i hemo mua, mai ka opu mai, o ka'u ia, a o na hanau mua a pau o na holoholona, ina ho bipi, a ina he hipa.
34.20: Aka, o ka hanau mua o ka hoki, e panai aku oe i keiki hipa; a i ole oe e panai, e uhai oe i koua a-i. E hoola panai hoi oe i kau mau hiapo kane a pau. Mai ike nele ia kekahi imua o'u.
34.21: Eono la kau e hana'i, aka, e hoomaha oe i ka hiku o ka la. I ka wa kanu, a i ka wa hoiliili ai, e hoomaha no oe.
34.22: E malama hoi oe i ka ahaaina hebedoma, no ka hoiliili mua ana i ka palaoa, a i ka ahaaina o ka hoiliili i ka puni ana o ka makahiki.
34.23: I ekolu no hoikeia'na i ka makahiki hookahi o ka oukou poe keikikane a pau imua o Iehova, ke Akua, ke Akua hoi o ka Iseraela.
34.24: No ka mea, e kipaku aku au i ko na aina imua ou. a e hoopalahalaha ae i kou mau mokuna; aole hoi e kuko mai kekahi kanaka i kou aina i ka wa e pii aku ai oe e ikeia imua o Iehova, kou Akua, ekolu pii ana o ka makahiki.
34.25: Mai kaumaha oe i ke koko o kou mohai me ka mea hu; mai hookoe hoi i ka mohai o ka ahaaina moliaola, a kakahiaka.
34.26: E lawe mai no oe i ka mua o na hua mua o kou aina iloko o ka hale o Iehova, o kou Akua. Mai hoolapalapa oe i ke keiki kao iloko o ka waiu o kona makuwahine.
34.27: I mai la o Iehova ia Mose, E palapala oe i keia mau olelo: no ka mea, ma ke ano o keia mau olelo ka'u i hana aku ai i berita me oe, a me ka Iseraela.
34.28: Malaila no ia me Iehova hookahi kanaha ao, hookahi kanaha po; aole ia i ai i ka ai, aole hoi i inu i ka wai. A palapala iho la ia ma na papa i na olelo o ka berita, i na olelo he umi.
34.29: A iho mai la o Mose, mai ka mauna o Sinai mai, aia no iloko o ko Mose lima na papa kanawai elua, i ka wa i iho mai ai ia mai ka mauna mai, aole o Mose i ike i ka puwa ana o ka ili o kona maka, i ka wa i kamailio pu ai oia me ia.
34.30: A ike aku la o Aarona, a me na mamo a pau a Iseraela ia Mose, aia hoi, ua puwa ka ili o kona maka; makau iho la lakou ke hookokoke ia ia.
34.31: Hea mai la o Mose ia lakou; hoi aku la o Aarona a me na luna a pau o kanaka io na la: a kamailio ae la o Mose me lakou.
34.32: A mahope iho, hookokeke na mamo a pau a Iseraela: a kauoha mai la ia ia lakou i na mea a pau a Iehova i olelo mai ai ia ia, ma ka mauna i Sinai.
34.33: Uhi mai la o Mose i ka pale ma kona maka, a pau kana kamailio ana me lakou.
34.34: A i ka wa i komo aku ai o Mose imua i ke alo o Iehova e olelo me ia, wehe ae la ia i ka pale a hiki i ka wa i puka mai ai mawaho mai; a puka mai la ia mawaho, a olelo mai i na mamo a Iseraela i na mea i kauohaia mai ia ia.
34.35: A ike aku la na mamo a Iseraela i ka maka o Mose, ua puwa ka ili o ko Mose maka: a uhi hou ae la o Mose i ka pale maluna o kona maka, a komo hou aku la ia e olelo pu me ia.

35.1: HOAKOAKOA iho la o Mose i ka aha kanaka a pau o ka Iseraela, i mai la ia lakou, Eia na olelo a Iehova i kauoha mai ai, i hana oukou ia mau mea.
35.2: I eono la e hanaia'i ka hana, aka o ka hiku o ka la, he la hoano ia, he Sabati e hoomaha'i no Iehova. O ka mea hana i ka hana ia la, e pepehiia oia.
35.3: Mai hoa oukou i ke ahi ma ko oukou mau wahi e noho ai a pau loa, i ka la Sabati.
35.4: Olelo mai la o Mose i ka aha kanaka a pau o ka Iseraela, i mai la, Eia ka mea a Iehova i kauoha mai ai, i mai la,
35.5: E lawe oukou, maiwaena aku o oukou, i mohai na Iehova; o na mea naau manawalea a pau, e lawe mai lakou i mohai na Iehova; i gula, a i kala, a i keleawe,
35.6: A i uliuli, a i poni, a i ulaula, a i olona keokeo, a i hulu kao;
35.7: A me na ili hipakane i hooluu ulaula ia, a me na ili tehasa, a me ka laau sitima;
35.8: A me ka aila no ka malamalama, a me na hua ala no ka aila poni, a no ka mea ala maikai;
35.9: A me na pohaku onika, a me na pohaku e kau ai maloko o ka epoda, a maloko o ka paleumauma.
35.10: A e hele mai no na mea naau akamai a pau, a e hana i na mea a pau a Iehova i kauoha mai ai;
35.11: I ka halelewa, i kona halelole a me kona uhi, a me kona mau lou, a me kona mau papa, a me kona mau auamo, a me kona mau kia, a me kona mau kumu;
35.12: I ka pahu, a me kona mau auamo, a me ka noho aloha, a me ka paku e uhi ai;
35.13: I ka papaaina, a me kona mau auamo, a me kona oihana a pau, a me ka berena hoike;
35.14: I ka ipukukui hoi no ka malamalama, a me kona oihana, a me kona mau ipu aila, me ka aila no ka malamalama;
35.15: I ke kuahu no ka mea ala, a me kona mau auamo, a me ka aila poni, a me ka mea ala maikai, a me ka paku no ka puka e komo aku ai iloko o ka halelewa;
35.16: I ke kuahu no ka mohaikuni, a me kona papa manamana pukapuka, a me kona mau auamo, a me kona mau oihana a pau, a me ka ipu auau, a me kona kumu;
35.17: I na paku o ke kahua, a me kona mau kia, a me ko lakou mau kumu, a me ka paku no ka puka o ke kahua;
35.18: I na makia o ka halelewa, a me na makia o ke kahua, a me ko lakou mau kaula;
35.19: I na lole no ka hana, e hana'i i ka hana ma kahi laa, i na kahiko laa no Aarona ke kahuna, a me na kahiko o kana mau keikikane, e lawelawe ai ma ka oihana kahuna.
35.20: A hele aku la ke anaina kanaka a pau o na mamo a Iseraela, mai ko Mose alo aku.
35.21: A hele mai no lakou, o kela mea keia mea i hooeueuia e kona naau, o kela mea keia mea hoi i hooikaikaia e kona uhane, a lawe mai lakou i ko Iehova haawina no ka hana o ka halelewa o ke anaina kanaka, a no kana hana a pau, a no na kahiko laa.
35.22: A hele mai lakou, o na kane, a me na wahine, o ka poe a pau i makemake ma ka naau, a lawe mai la i na kupee lima, a me na gula pepeiao, a me na apo, a ma na gula a-i, a me na mea gula a pau loa; a o kela mea, keia mea i haawi, haawi oia i gula no Iehova.
35.23: A o kela kanaka keia kanaka i loaa ia ia ka uliuli, ka poni, a me ka ulaula, a me ke olona keokeo, a me ka hulu kao, a me na ili ulaula o na hipakane, a me na ili tehasa, lawe mai no lakou la mau mea.
35.24: O kela mea keia mea i haawi i ka haawina kala, a keleawe, lawe mai no oia i ka Iehova haawina. A o kela kanaka keia kanaka i loaa ia ia ka laau sitima no kahi hana e hana'i, lawe mai la oia ia.
35.25: A o na wahine a pau i akamai ma ka naau, milo lakou me ko lakou lima, a lawe mai la i ka mea a lakou i milo ai, i ka uliuli, a me ka poni, a me ka ulaula, a me ke olona keokeo.
35.26: A o na wahine a pau i hooikaikaia ma ka naau, i mea e akamai ai, milo lakou i ka hulu kao.
35.27: A lawe mai na'lii i pohaku onika, a me na pohaku e kau ai ma ka epoda, a ma ka paleumauma;
35.28: A me na mea ala, a me ka aila no ka malamalama, a no ka aila poni a me ka mea ala maikai.
35.29: Lawe mai no na mamo a Iseraela i makana aloha no Iehova, o kela kane keia kane i makemake ma ka naau e lawe, no ka hana a pau a Iehova i kauoha mai ai ma ka lima o Mose.
35.30: Olelo mai la o Mose i na mamo a Iseraela, E nana hoi, ma ka inoa no i hea mai ai o Iehova ia Bezalela, i ke keiki a Uri, i ke keiki a Hura, no ka ohana a Iuda;
35.31: A ua hoopiha ia ia i ka uhane o ke Akua, i ke akamai, a i ka naauao, a i ka ike, a i ke ano o na hana a pau;
35.32: I imi oia i na hana akamai, e hana i ke gula, a i ke kala, a i ke keleawe,
35.33: A i ke okioki pohaku ana, a me ke kapilipili, i ke kalai laau, a me ka hana i na hana akamai a pau.
35.34: A ua haawi hoi oia iloko o kona naau i ke ao aku, oia, a me Aholiaba, ke keiki a Ahisamaka, no ka ohana a Dana.
35.35: Ua hoopiha oia ia laua i ke akamai o ka naau, e hana i na hana a pau, o ka mea kahakaha, a me ka mea hana akamai, a me ka mea humuhumu i ka uliuli, a me ka poni, a me ka ulaula, a me ke olona keokeo, a me ka mea upena, a me ka mea hana i na hana a pau, a me ka mea imi i ka hana akamai,

36.1: A LAILA hana o Bezalela, a me Aholiaba, a me na kanaka a pau i akamai ka naau, na mea a Iehova i haawi mai ai i ke akamai, a me ka naauao e ike ai i ka hana i na hana a pau no ka oihana o ke keenakapu, e like me na mea a pau a Iehova i kauoha mai ai.
36.2: A hea aku la o Mose ia Bezalela, a me Aholiaba, a me na kanaka a pau i akamai ma ka naau, a Iehova i haawi mai ai i naau akamai, i na mea a pau hoi i ikaika ma ko lakou naau e hele e kokua i ka hana.
36.3: A loaa ia lakou, na Mose ae, na haawina a pau a na mamo a Iseraela i lawe mai ai no ka hana o ka oihana o ke keenakapu, i mea e paa ai ka hana. A lawe mai no lakou ia ia i makana hou i kela kakahiaka, i keia kakahiaka.
36.4: A hele mai la na kanaka akamai a pau, ka poe i hana i na hana a pau o ke keenakapu, mai ka hana mai, a lakou i hana'i.
36.5: A olelo mai la lakou ia Mose, i mai la, Ke lawe mai nei na kanaka a nui okoa aku, mamua o ka lawelawe ana i ka hana a Iehova i kauaha mai ai e hana.
36.6: A kauoha ae la o Mose, a hookala aku la lakou ia, a puni kahi i hoomoana'i, i ae la, Mai hana hou kekahi kanaka, aole hoi kekahi wahine i hana no ka haawina o ke keenakapu. A hookiia iho la ka lawe ana mai o na kanaka.
36.7: No ka mea, ua lawa na mea e paa ai ka hana a pau e hanaia'i a keu aku no.
36.8: A o ka poe mea naau akamai a pau i hana i ka hana o ka halelewa, hana lakou i umi mau pale, he olona i hiloia, he uliuli, he poni, a me ka ulaula; hana no oia ia mau mea na kerubima, o ka hana a ka poe akamai.
36.9: He iwakaluakumamawalu kubita ka loihi o kekahi pale, eha kubita ka laula o kekahi pale, ua like hoi ka nui o na pale a pau.
36.10: A hai pu oia i na pale elima, kekahi i kekahi, a hui pu oia i kekahi mau lima, kekahi i kekahi.
36.11: A hana iho la no hoi ia i na puka lou uliuli, ma ke kae o kekahi pale, ma ka pelupelu ana maloko o ka huina. A pela no oia i hana'i, ma ke kihi loa o kekahi pale, ma kahi i huiia'i me ka lua.
36.12: Hana no oia i kanalima puka lou ma kekahi pale, a hana no hoi i kanalima puka lou ma ke kae o ka pale, kahi i haiia'i me ka lua. O na puka lou ka mea i paa ai kekahi i kekahi.
36.13: A hana oia i kanalima lou gula, a hui oia i na pale, kekahi me kekahi a paa i na lou. A lilo iho la ia i halelewa hookahi.
36.14: A hana no hoi oia i pale hulu kao no ka hale maluna o ka halelewa: hana oia ia mau mea, he umikumamakahi pale.
36.15: He kanakolu kubita ka loihi o kekahi pale, a eha no kubita ka laula o kekahi pale; ua like ka nui o na pale he umikumamakahi.
36.16: A hui oia i elima mau pale a kaawale lakou, a i eono mau pale a kaawale lakou.
36.17: A hana iho la no oia i kanalima puka lou ma ke kae loa o kekahi pale ma ka hui ana, a hana no hoi oia i kanalima puka lou ma ke kae o ka pale i hui me ka lua.
36.18: A hana no hoi oia i kanalima lou keleawe e paa ai ka hale, i lilo ia i hookahi.
36.19: A hana no hoi oia i uhi no ka hale, he mau ili hipakane i hooluu ulaula ia, a maluna aku, i uhi hou, he mau ili tehasa.
36.20: A hana no hoi oia i mau papa no ka halelewa, he laau sitima, e ku pono ana iluna.
36.21: He umi kabita ka loa o kekahi papa, a hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua ka laula o kekahi papa.
36.22: Elua no komo ko ka papa hookahi, ua like no ke kaawale ana o kekahi, a me kekahi. Pela no ia i hana'i no na papa a pau o ka halelewa.
36.23: A hana oia i papa no ka halelewa, he iwakalua papa no ka aoao hema ma ka hema.
36.24: A hana oia i hookahi kanaha kumu kala malalo iho o na papa he iwakalua; elua kumu malalo o ka papa hookahi, no kona mau komo elua, a elua hoi kumu malalo o kekahi papa no kona mau komo elua.
36.25: A no kela aoao hoi o ka halelewa, ma ke kihi akau, hana no oia i iwakalua papa,
36.26: A me ko lakou kumu kala he kanaha; elua kumu malalo iho o kekahi papa, elua hoi kumu malalo iho o kekahi papa.
36.27: A no na aoao o ka halelewa, ma ke komohana, hana oia i eono papa.
36.28: A hana oia i elua papa no na kihi o ka halelewa, ma na aoao elua.
36.29: A ua huiia ia mau mea malalo, a ua huiia ma na poo ma ke apo hookahi. Pela no oia i hana'i ia laua a elua, ma na kihi elua.
36.30: Ewalu no ia mau papa a o ko lakou mau kumu, he umikumamaono kumu kala, elua no kumu, a elua hoi kumu malalo o ka papa hookahi.
36.31: A hana no oia i mau laau ki, he laau sitima; i elima no na papa ma kekahi aoao o ka halelewa,
36.32: A i elima hoi ki no na papa o kekahi aoao o ka halelewa, a i elima hoi ki no na papa o ka halelewa no na aoao ma ke komohana.
36.33: A hana iho la oia i ka laau ki mawaenakonu, e puka loa, mai kekahi kala a i kekahi kala.
36.34: A wahi iho la oia i na papa i ke gula, a hana iho la i ko lakou mau apo, he gula, i wahi no na laau ki, a wahi iho la i na ki i ke guia.
36.35: A hana iho la oia i paku, he uliuli, a he ulaula, a he olona i hiloia, a hana no hoi i na kerubima, he hana na ka mea akamai.
36.36: A hana oia i eha kia nona, he laau sitima, a uhi oia ia mau mea i ke gula. He gula no ko lakou mau lou, a hoohehee oia no lakou i mau kumu kala eha.
36.37: Hana iho la no hoi oia i pale no ka puka komo o ka halelewa, he uliuli, he poni, he ulaula, a me ke olona i hiloia, ka hana a ka mea humuhumu lope ano e;
36.38: A me na kia ona elima, a me ko lakou mau lou; a uhi no hoi oia i ko lakou mau poo, a me ko lakou mau auka e paa ai i ke gula. Aka, he keleawe no ko lakou mau kumu elima.

37.1: A HANA iho la o Bezalela i ka pahu, he laau sitima; elua kubita a me ka hapalua kona loihi, a hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona laula; a hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona kiekie:
37.2: A uhi iho la oia ia mea i ke gula maikai, maloko, a mawaho, a hana iho la oia nona i lei gula a puni.
37.3: A hoohehee oia i eha apo gula nona, no kona mau kihi eha; i elua apo ma kekahi aoao ona, a i elua apo ma kekahi aoao ona.
37.4: A hana iho la oia i mau auamo laau sitima, a uhi iho la ia mau mea i ke gula.
37.5: Hookomo ae la oia i na auamo iloko o na apo, ma na aoao o ka pahu e amo ai i ka pahu.
37.6: A hana iho la oia i ka noho aloha, he gula maikai; elua kubita a me ka hapalua kona loa, a hookahi kubita a me ka hapalua kona laula.
37.7: A hana iho la oia i elua kerabima, he gula paa wale no, hookahi apana ia i hana'i ia laua ma na welau o ka noho aloha.
37.8: Hookahi kerubima ma kekahi welau, ma keia aoao, a o kekahi kerubima ma kekahi welau ma kela aoao. Maluna o ka noho aloha oia i hana'i i na kerubima, ma kona mau welau elua.
37.9: A hohola ae la na kerubima i ko laua mau eheu iluna, a uhi ao la ko laua mau eheu i ka noho aloha, a ku pono iho la ko laua mau maka kekahi i kekahi, ma ka noho aloha na maka o na kerubima.
37.10: Hana no hoi oia i ka papaaina, he laau sitima; elua kubita kona loa, hookahi kubita kona laula, a hookahi kubita a me ka hapa kona kiekie.
37.11: A uhi iho la oia ia i ke gula maikai, a hana ae la i lei gula nona a puni.
37.12: A hana no hoi oia i kae a puni ia mea, i hookahi lima ka laula, a hana ae la ia i lei gula no ua kae la a puni.
37.13: A hoohehee oia nona i eha apo gula, a kau oia i na apo ma na kihi eha ma kona mau wawae eha.
37.14: I ku pono na apo i ko kae, na wahi e komo ai na auamo e lawe i ka papaaina.
37.15: A nana iho la oia i na auamo, he laau sitima, a uhi iho la ia lakou i ke gula, i mea e lawe ai i ka papaaina.
37.16: A hana no hoi oia i ka oihana maluna o ka papa, i kona mau kiaha, a me kona mau puna, a me kona mau ipu, a me na poi e ninini ai, he gula maikai.
37.17: A hana iho la ia i ka ipukukui manamana he gula maikai, hana oia i ka ipukukui he gula wale no a paa, o kona kumu, a me kona lala, o kona mau puupuu, a me kona mau pua, oia apana hookahi no.
37.18: Eono no lala e puka ana mawaho o kona mau aoao; ekolu manamana o ka ipukukui mai kekahi aoao ona mai, a ekolu manamana o ka ipukukui, mai kela aoao ona mai.
37.19: Ekolu no ipu e like me na alemona ma ka mana hookahi, he puupuu, a me ka pua; a ekolu no ipu e like me na alemona ma kekahi mana, he puupuu a me ka pua: a pela wale no ma na manamana eono, e puka ana mawaho o ka ipukukui manamana.
37.20: Eha no ipu ma ke knmukukui, ua hanaia e like me na alemona, o kona mau puupuu, a me kona mau pua.
37.21: A he puupuu malalo o kona mau lala elua, a he puupuu malalo iho o kona mau lala elua, a he puupuu malalo iho o kona mau lala elua, e like me na lala eono, o puka mai ana mawaho ona.
37.22: Hookahi no apana ko lakou puupuu, a me ko lakou manamana. Hookahi no apana ia hana a pau, he gula maikai.
37.23: A hana no hoi oia i kona mau ipu aila ehiku, a me kona mau upaahi, a me kona mau upakolikukui, he gula maikai.
37.24: Hana no oia ia mea, a me kona oihana a pau, hookahi talena gula maikai.
37.25: A hana no hoi oia i ke kuahu no ka mea ala, he laau sitima: hookahi kubita kona loa, hookahi kubita kona laula, he ahalike; a elua kubita kona kiekie, a hookahi no ia apana me kona mau pepeiao elua.
37.26: A uhi oia ia mea i ke gala maikai, ma ko luna ona a me kona mau aoao a puni, a me kona mau pepeiao. A hana no hoi oia i lei gala a puni ia mea.
37.27: A hana iho la oia i elua apo gula nona, malalo iho o kona lei, ma kona mau kihi elua, ma na aoao ona elua, i wahi no na auamo, e amo ai ia mea.
37.28: A hana iho la oia i na auamo, he laau sitima, a uhi iho la ia mau mea i ke gula.
37.29: A hana iho la oia i ka aila poni laa, a me ka mea ala maikai i hua ala loa, e like me ka hana ana a ka mea kaawili laau.

38.1: A HANA no hoi oia i ke kuahu no ka mohaikuni: elima kubita kona loihi, a elima kubita kona laula, he ahalike: a ekolu kubita kona kiekie.
38.2: A hana oia i kona mau pepeiao, ma na kihi eha ona; no ia mea hookahi no na pepeiao, a uhi oia ia i ke keleawe.
38.3: A hana oia i na oihana a pau o ke kaahu, i na ipu, a me na papale, a me na kiaha, a me na o io, a me na ipu ahi; hana no oia i kona oihana a pau, he keleawe.
38.4: A hana no hoi oia no ke kuahu, i papa manamana pukapuka malalo iho o ke kae ona, mawaenakonu.
38.5: A hoohehee oia i eha mau apo no na welau eha o ua mea manamana keleawe la, i wahi no na auamo.
38.6: A hana oia i na auamo, he laau sitima, a ubi iho la ia laua i ko keleawe.
38.7: A hookomo oia i na auamo iloko o na apo ma na aoao o ke kuahu i mea e lawe ai, a hana oia i ke kuahu, he papa laau, ua kawaha.
38.8: A hana oia i ka ipu auau, he keleawe, ko loko o kona kumu, he keleawe, a me na aniani keleawe o ka poe e akoakoa nui ana, ka poe i akoakoa ma ka puka o ka halelewa o ke anaina.
38.9: A hana oia i ke kahua, ma ka aoao hema, ma ka hema hoi; a o na pale o ke kahua, he olona ia i hiloia, hookahi haneri kubita.
38.10: O ko lakou mau pou, he iwakalua, o ko lakou mau Kumu keleawe, he iwakalua. O na lou o na pou, a me ko lakou auka e paa ai, ne kala.
38.11: A no ka aoao akau, hookahi haneri kubita, o ko lakou mau pou, he iwakalua, a o ko lakou mau kumu keleawe, he iwakalua. O na lou o na pou, a me ko lakou auka e paa ai, he kala.
38.12: A no ka aoao komohana, he pale no, he kanalima kubita ka loihi, o ko lakou mau pou, he umi, a o ko lakou mau kumu he umi. O na lou o na pau a me ko lakou auka e paa ai, he kala.
38.13: A no ka aoao hikina ma na hikina, he kanalima kubita.
38.14: A o na pale ma kekahi aoao o ka puka, he umikumamalima kubita; a o ko lakou mau pau ekolu, a o ko lakou mau kumu, ekolu.
38.15: A no kela aoao o ka puka o ke kahua, he mau pale ma keia aoao a ma kela aoao, he umikumamalima kubita, o ko lakou mau pau ekolu, a o ko lakou mau kumu ekolu.
38.16: O na pale a pau a puni ke kahua, he olona no i hiloia.
38.17: A o na kumu no na pou, he keleawe ia. O na lou o na pou, a me ko lakou mau auka e paa ai, he kala no. A o ka uhi ana o ko lakou mau poo, he kala: a paa no na pau a pau o ke kahua i na auka kala.
38.18: A o ka pale o ka puka o ke kahua, he hana no ia a ka mea humuhumu lope ano e, he uliuli, he poni, he ulaula, he olona i hiloia: he iwakalua kubita ka loihi, a o ke kiekie ma ka laula, elima no kubita, e like me na pale o ke kahua.
38.19: A o ko lakou mau pou, eha, a. o ko lakou mau kumu, eha no, he keleawe; o ko lakou lou, he kala, a o ka uhi ana o ko lakou mau poo, a o ko lakou mau auka e paa ai, he kala no.
38.20: A o na makia a pau o ka halelewa, a me ke kahua e puni ana, he keleawe no ia.
38.21: Eia ka huina o ka halelewa, o ka halelewa hoi o ke kanawai, e like me ia i heluia, mamuli o ke kauoha a Mose, no ka hana a ko Levi, ma ka lima o Itamara, ke keiki a Aarona, ke kahuna.
38.22: A hana iho la o Bezalela, ke keiki a Uri, ke keiki a Hura, no ka ohana a Iuda, i na mea a pau a Iehova i kauoha mai ai ia Mose.
38.23: A me ia pu no o Aholiaba, ke keiki a Ahisamaka, no ka ohana a Dana, he kahuna kalai, he mea akamai i ka hana, a he mea humuhumu lope ano e, he uliuli, a he poni, a he ulaula, a me ke olona keokeo.
38.24: A o ke gula a pau i hanaia ma ka hana o ia mea laa, o ke gula laa he iwakaluakumamaiwa talena a me na sekela ehiku haneri me kanakolu, ma ka sekela o ke keenakapu.
38.25: A o ke kala o ka poe i heluia o ka aha kanaka, hookahi haneri talena, a me ka sekela hookahi tausani, ehiku haneri, me kanahikukumamalima, ma ka sekela o ke keenakapu.
38.26: He beka no kela kanaka keia kanaka, he hapalua sekela hoi, ma ka sekela o ke keenakapu, no kela mea keia mea i hele ae i ka helu ana, mai ka iwakalua o ka makahiki a keu aku, no na kanaka eono haneri kumamakolu tausani, elima haneri, a me kanalima.
38.27: A noloko o ia haneri talena kala, i hooheheeia'i na kumu o ke keenakapu, a me na kumu o ka paku: hookahi haneri kumu, noloko o ia mau haneri talena, hookahi talena, hookahi kumu.
38.28: A noloko mai o ke tausani sekela a me na haneri keu ehiku, a me kanahikukumamalima, hana iho la oia i mau lou no na pou, a uhi iho la i ko lakou poo, a hoopaa ne la ia lakou i na auka.
